provenance.rawSnippet:
oṁ svabhāvaśuddhāḥ sarvadharmāḥ svabhāvaśuddho ’ham
oṁ bodhicittam utpādaya aham
oṁ sarva-tathāgata-dhūpa-pūjā-megha-samudra-spharaṇa-samaye hūṁ.
oṁ sarva-tathāgata-puṣpa-pūjā-megha-samudra-spharaṇa-samaye hūṁ.
oṁ sarva-tathāgata-āloka-pūjā-megha-samudra-spharaṇa-samaye hūṁ.
oṁ sarva-tathāgata-gandha-pūjā-megha-samudra-spharaṇa-samaye hūṁ.
oṁ sarva-tathāgata-naivedya-pūjā-megha-samudra-spharaṇa-samaye hūṁ.
oṁ sarva-tathāgata-śabda-pūjā-megha-samudra-spharaṇa-samaye hūṁ
namaḥ sarva-tathāgatānāṃ tadyathā oṁ namaḥ sūkasaṃ namaḥ tārāyai tāramātā.
namas tāre ture vīre kṣana-dyuti-nibhekṣaṇe. trailokya-nātha-vaktrābja-vikasat-keśarodbhave.
namaḥ śata-śarac-candra-saṃpūrṇa-paṭalānane tārā-sahasra-nikara-prahasat-kiraṇojjvale.
namaḥ kanaka-nīlābja-pāṇi-padma-vibhūṣite dāna-vīrya-tapaḥ-śānti-titikṣā-dhyāna-gocare.
namas tathāgatoṣṇīṣa-vijayānanta-cāriṇi aśeṣa-pāramitā-prāpta-jina-putra-niṣevite.
namas tuttāra-hūṁ-kāra-pūritāśā-dig-antare sapta-loka-kramākrānti niḥśeṣākarṣaṇakṣame.
namaḥ śakrānala-brahma-marud-viśveśvarārcite bhūta-vetāla-gandharva-gaṇa-yakṣa-puras-kṛte.
namas traḍ iti phaṭ-kāra-para-yantra-pramardini pratyālīḍha-pada-nyāse śikhi-jvālākulekṣane.
namas ture mahā-ghore māra-vīra-vināśane bhṛkuṭī-kṛta-vaktrābja-sarva-śatru-niṣūdani.
namas tri-ratna-mudrāṅka-hṛdyāṅguli-vibhūṣite bhūṣitāśeṣa-dik-cakra-nikara-svakarākule.
namaḥ pramuditāṭopa-mukuṭā-kṣipta-mālini hasat-prahasa-tuttāre māra-loka-vaśaṅkari.
namaḥ samanta-bhūpāla-paṭalākarṣaṇa-kṣame calad-bhṛkuṭi-hūṁ-kāra-sarvāpada-vimocani.
namaḥ śikhaṇḍa-khaṇḍeṇdu-mukuṭābharaṇojjvale amitābha-jaṭābhāra-bhāsure kiraṇa-dhruve.
namaḥ kalpānta-hutabhug-jvālā-mālāntara-sthite ālīḍha-muditā-bandha-ripu-cakra-vināśani.
namaḥ kara-talāghāta-caraṇāhata-bhūtale bhṛkuṭī-kṛta-hūṁ-kāra-sapta-pātāla-bhedini.
namaḥ śive śubhe śānte śānta-nirvāṇa-gocare svāhā-praṇava-saṃyukte mahā-pātaka-nāśani.
namaḥ pramuditābandha-ripu-gātra-prabhedini daśākṣara-pada-nyāse vidyā-hūṁ-kāra-dīpite.
namas ture padāghāta-hūṁ-kārākāra-bījite meru-mandara-kailāsa-bhuvana-traya-cālini.
namaḥ sura-sarākāra-hariṇāṅka-kara-sthite tāra-dvir-ukta-phaṭ-kāra aśeṣa-viṣa-nāśani.
namaḥ sura-gaṇādhyakṣa-sura-kinnara-sevite ābandha-muditā-bhoga-kali-duḥsvapna-nāśani.
namaś candrārka-sampūrṇa-nayana-dyuti-bhāsure hara-dvir-ukta-tuttāre viṣama-jvara-nāśani.
namas tri-tattva-vinyāsa-śiva-śakti-samanvite graha-vetāla-yakṣaugha-nāśani pravare ture.
mantra-mūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namas-kāraika-viṃśakam yaḥ paṭhet prayato dhīmān devyām bhakti-samanvitaḥ.
sāyaṃ vā prātar utthāya smaret sarvābhaya-pradam sarva-pāpa-praśamanaṃ sarva-durgati-nāśanam.
abhiṣikto bhavet tūrṇaṃ saptabhir jina-koṭibhiḥ asmin mahattvam āsādya so ’nte bauddha-padaṃ vrajet.
viṣaṃ tasya mahā-ghoraṃ sthāvaraṃ cātha jaṅgamam smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yāti khāditam pītam eva vā.
graha-jvara-viṣārtānām paramārti-vināśanam anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ dvis-tri-saptābhivartanam.
putra-kāmo labhet putraṃ dhana-kāmo labhed dhanam sarva-kāmān avāpnoti na vighnaiḥ pratihanyate.

Oṁ , Vajrajvālā, kill! Kill all the spirits! Hūṁ phaṭ
Oṁ , Vajrāyuṣā, flow! Flow into him!
Oṁ , summon the consciousness, summon! Revive the dead! Hrīḥ , āḥ
Oṁ , the glorious Sundarī of the great spirit family, hūṁ ! Oṁ , the glorious Sundarī of victory, hrīḥ ! Oṁ , the stainless Sundarī, āḥ ! Oṁ , the glorious Sundarī of pleasure, vāḥ ! Oṁ , the glorious Sundarī that captivates the mind, dhīḥ ! Oṁ , the glorious, terrifying Sundarī, iḥ ! Oṁ , the glorious, brilliant white Sundarī, maṃ ! Oṁ , the glorious Sundarī with the sweet look in her eyes, bhīḥ !
Oṁ , summon, summon! Sruṃ hrīḥ ! Summon such-and-such spirit, hūṁ phaṭ !
Oṁ hrīḥ hūṁ aḥ
Oṁ hūṁ ! Summon them, summon! Guard the pledge of all female spirits! Kill, kill! Bind, bind! Trample them, trample them! Hey! Hey you, great wild one who inhabits charnel grounds, please come swiftly! Dhruṃ phaṭ !
Oṁ , shake, shake! Shake thoroughly, shake! Run, run! Drive them on, drive them on! Enter, enter! Strike, strike! Stay, stay! Guard the pledge! Hey, hey you who roam charnel grounds! Hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Svāhā !
Oṁ , move, move! Burn them, burn! O great spirit, you who are fond of and well disposed toward practitioners! Go, go! Go in various directions, go! Summon the spirits, summon! Make them speak, make them speak! Break the evil demons, break them! Seize them, seize! Hūṁ hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Hrīḥ svāhā !
Oṁ , Ghoramukhī, you who inhabit charnel grounds! You who are favorably disposed toward practitioners and grant them indestructible accomplishments! Oṁ oṁ oṁ oṁ ! Homage to you! Svāhā !
Oṁ , Jarjaramukhī! Harm, harm! Overwhelm them with sorrow! You inspire fear in all enemies! Strike, strike! Burn, burn! Cook, cook! Murder, murder! You diminish the chances of my untimely death. You instill fear in all nāgas. You are the loud-laughing queen of all the spirits. Thā thā thā thā ! Dhā dhā dhā dhā ! Oṁ oṁ oṁ oṁ ! Svāhā !
Oṁ , Kamalalocanī who is fond of humans! Dispeller of all suffering! Fond of practitioners! Conquer, conquer! You of divine beauty! Hrīḥ ! Seize, seize! Jaḥ jaḥ ! Hūṁ hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Homage to you! Svāhā !
Oṁ , Vikaṭamukhī with fangs bared and eyes ablaze! You instill fear in all yakṣas. Run, run! Go, go! “Hey! Hey practitioner! What do you command me to do?” Svāhā !
Oṁ , Dhudhurī, the piśācī who performs tasks! Speak, speak! Shake them up, shake! You who are worshipped by great asuras, split them, split! Break, break! O great piśācī who performs tasks! “Hey! Hey, practitioner! What can I do for you?” Hrīḥ ! Hūṁ hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Svāhā !
Oṁ , shake them, shake! Move, move! Summon them, summon them! Break, break! Paralyze, paralyze! Bewilder, bewilder! You with fangs that flash like lightning! You who grant the best indestructible accomplishment! Ha ha ha ! Hūṁ hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Svāhā !
Oṁ , Saumyamukhī! Summon them, summon them! Conquer all the spirits, conquer! “Hey! Hey, great practitioner!” The practitioner commands, “Remain, remain! Protect the pledge!” Svāhā !
Oṁ , truṃ hūṁ hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Svāhā !
Oṁ , bhū ! Blaze up! Hūṁ phaṭ !
Oṁ oṁ. Hrīḥ hrīḥ. Hūṁ hūṁ. He he! Phaṭ phaṭ! Svāhā!
Oṁ , you who spread wild panic! Loud-laughing one who is fond of practitioners! Great one of many forms! Source of gems! One with gold in her hands! Destroyer of Yama! Appeaser of all suffering! Oṁ oṁ oṁ oṁ . Hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ . Please swiftly grant me accomplishment! Hrīḥ , jaḥ , svāhā !
Oṁ , Destroyer of Yama who prevents untimely death, bearing a sword and spear in your hands, please grant me swift accomplishment! So commands the practitioner. Hrīḥ svāhā !
Oṁ , you with golden earrings! Burn, burn! Blaze up, blaze! You who are adorned with divine earrings! The crusher of Rāvaṇa! The lord commands you! Svāhā !
Oṁ , you with knitted brows! Summon them, summon! Run, run! Burn, burn! You with a fiery mouth! Come, come! Rouser of vetālas! Enter, enter! Hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ! The lord commands you! Hrīḥ svāhā !
Oṁ , the crusher of ancestral spirits! Summon them, summon! Conquer, conquer! You who are worshipped by all asuras! Hūṁ , jaḥ , svāhā !
Oṁ , you who are fond of carnal delights! The divine-eyed queen of lovers! You who bewitch the world! O fortunate one adorned with a golden necklace! Please enter, enter with the sound of your anklets! Fulfill the needs, fulfill! You who are fond of practitioners! Hrīḥ , svāhā !
Oṁ , Rāhu, Rāhu! Seize, seize the great servant spirits in order to benefit those who are poor! Oṁ , hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ ! Grant me magical power over meat! Svāhā !
Hūṁ phaṭ
Oṁ , remain! Give an accomplishment, hūṁ !
Oṁ , enter, O Wrath! Hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ ! Āḥ !
Oṁ , the vajra of accomplishment! Hūṁ !
Oṁ , kill, crush, and destroy evil! Hūṁ phaṭ !
Oṁ , Wrath! Please enter! Hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ ! Aḥ !
Oṁ , Vajra! Please enter and take control! Hūṁ !
Oṁ , kill, O vajra! Hūṁ !
Oṁ , burn, O vajra! Hūṁ !
Oṁ , O blazing vajra! Hūṁ !

verses.iast: Oṁ , Kamalalocanī who is fond of humans! Dispeller of all suffering! Fond of practitioners! Conquer, conquer! You of divine beauty! Hrīḥ ! Seize, seize! Jaḥ jaḥ ! Hūṁ hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Homage to you! Svāhā !

verses.iast: Oṁ , Vikaṭamukhī with fangs bared and eyes ablaze! You instill fear in all yakṣas. Run, run! Go, go! “Hey! Hey practitioner! What do you command me to do?” Svāhā !

verses.iast: Oṁ , Dhudhurī, the piśācī who performs tasks! Speak, speak! Shake them up, shake! You who are worshipped by great asuras, split them, split! Break, break! O great piśācī who performs tasks! “Hey! Hey, practitioner! What can I do for you?” Hrīḥ ! Hūṁ hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Svāhā !

verses.iast: Oṁ , shake them, shake! Move, move! Summon them, summon them! Break, break! Paralyze, paralyze! Bewilder, bewilder! You with fangs that flash like lightning! You who grant the best indestructible accomplishment! Ha ha ha ! Hūṁ hūṁ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Svāhā !

Appeaser of all suffering! Oṁ oṁ oṁ oṁ . Hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ . Please swiftly grant me accomplishment! Hrīḥ , jaḥ , svāhā !

[T02msitvatu:0] Mahāśītavatī
[T02msitvatu:1] namo bhagavatyai āryamahāśītavatyai /
[T02msitvatu:2] evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma /
[T02msitvatu:3] śītavane mahāśmaśāne iṅghikāyatanapratyuddeśe tatrāyuṣmān rāhulo 'tīva viheṭhyate /
[T02msitvatu:4] devagrahair nāgagrahair yakṣagrahai rākṣagrahair marutagrahair asuragrahair kinnaragrahair
[T02msitvatu:5] garuḍagrahair gandharvagrahair mahoragagrahair manuṣyagrahair amanuṣyagrahair pretagrahair
[T02msitvatu:6] bhūtagrahair piśācagrahair kumbhāṇḍagrahair dvīpibhiḥ kākair ulūkaiḥ kīṭaiḥ sarīsṛpair
[T02msitvatu:7] anyaiś ca manuṣyāmanuṣyaiḥ satvaiḥ /
[T02msitvatu:8] athāyuṣmān rāhulo yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrānta upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavantaṃ tripradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavataḥ purato rudann aśrūṇi pravartayati sma /
[T02msitvatu:9] atha bhagavān jānann eva rāhulam āmantrayate sma /
[T02msitvatu:10] kiṃ tvaṃ rāhula mama prataḥ sthitvā aśrūṇi pravartayasi /
[T02msitvatu:11] evam ukte āyuṣmān rāhulo bhagavantam etad avocat /

[T02vadhdhdu:0] Vasudhārādhāraṇīsūtra
[T02vadhdhdu:1] āryavasudhārādhāraṇīsūtra
[T02vadhdhdu:2] oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryaśrīvasudhārāyai /
[T02vadhdhdu:3] evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān kośāmbyāṃ mahānagaryāṃ viharati sma /
[T02vadhdhdu:4] kaṇṭakasaṃjñake mahāvanavare ghoṣitārāme mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdhaṃ pañcamātrair
[T02vadhdhdu:5] bhikṣuśataiḥ saṃbahulaiś ca śrāvakair asaṃkhyayaiś ca bodhisattvaiḥ sarvabuddhaguṇasamanvāgataiḥ /
[T02vadhdhdu:6] tatra khalu bhagavāṃs tasyām eva parṣadi tair eva parivṛtaḥ puraskṛtaḥ sarvadāridryavyādhiduḥkhārṇavapariśoṣaṇaṃ nāma dharmaparyāyaṃ deśayati sma /
[T02vadhdhdu:7] ādau kalyāṇaṃ madhye kalyāṇaṃ paryavasāne kalyāṇaṃ svarthaṃ suvyañjanaṃ kevalaṃ paripūrṇaṃ pariśuddhaṃ paryavadātaṃ brahmacaryaṃ saṃprakāśayati sma /
[T02vadhdhdu:8] tena khalu punaḥ samayena kauśāmbyāṃ mahānagaryāṃ sucandro nāma gṛhapatiḥ prativasati sma /
[T02vadhdhdu:9] upaśāntendriyopaśāntamānaso bahuputro bahuduhitaro bahubhṛtyajanasaṃpannaḥ śrāddho mahāśrāddhaḥ /
[T02vadhdhdu:10] tena khalu punaḥ samayena yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrānta upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavantam anekaśatasahasraṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ekānte nyaṣīdat /
[T02vadhdhdu:11] ekānte niṣaṇṇaḥ sucandro nāma gṛhapatir bhagavantam etad avocat /

prāṇāpānasamānākhyān udānavyānasañjñakān
nāgakūrmakṛkarāṃś ca devadattadhanañjayān
kṛtvaîtān ātmano bimbaṃ strītvaṃ nirmāyate punar iti
ete daśa vāyavaḥ śrīsarvabuddhasamāyogaḍākinījālasaṃvara .naye yena yena rutenôktās tāṃs tān apy āha
koṭākhyaḥ koṭavaḥ koṭaḥ koṭābhaś ca kaṭīrakaḥ
kolākhyaḥ kolavaḥ kolaḥ kolābhaś ca kalis tathā
etāni daśa nāmāni vajramukhīmahāyogatantre 'pi yathārutārthena daśavāyūn prāha | prāṇāpānodānasamānavyānodvāhavivāhasaṃvāhapravāhanirvāhāś cêti
vajraśiṣya uvāca | prāṇādidaśavāyavo 'smin kāye kutra prativasanti | kiṃ kurvanti ca brūhi bhagavan vajraguruḥ śāstā
vajragurur āha | pañca vāyavaḥ kāyavibhāge sthitvā kāyavyāpāraṃ kurvanti | pañca vāyavaś cakṣurādyāyatane sthitvā indriyavyāpāraṃ kurvanti
tatra prāṇo hṛdistho 'kṣobhyas tathāgataḥ | apāno gudastho ratnasambhavas tathāgataḥ | udānaḥ kaṇṭhastho 'mitābhas tathāgataḥ | samāno nābhistho 'moghasiddhis tathāgataḥ | vyānaḥ sarvasandhistho vairocanas tathāgata iti | udvāho rūpam | vivāhaḥ śabdaḥ | saṃvāho gandhaḥ | pravāho rasaḥ | nirvāhaḥ sparśaś cêti
ete daśa vāyavaḥ punar ucchvāsapraśvāsā bhavanti | te ca punar vāyavyādicaturmaṇḍalātmakā bhavanti | te ca punaś caturdevyātmakā bhavanti | te ca punaḥ pañcabhūtātmakā bhavanti | te ca punar ādarśādipañcajñānātmakā bhavanti | te ca punaḥ sitādipañcaraśmyātmakā bhavanti | te ca punaḥ pañcatathāgatātmakā bhavanti | te ca punas tryakṣarādhāro bhūtvā praveśasthitivyutthānakrameṇa vajrajāpaṃ kārayanti | te ca punar vāyavo 'kārasyâdhāro bhūtvā aśeṣavākpravyāhāraṃ kārayanti | te ca punar anāhataṃ vyāpya niḥsvabhāvā bhavanti
vajraśiṣya uvāca | kathaṃ bhagavann ete daśa vāyava ekānekasvabhāvena divārātrau svakāye spharaṇasaṃharaṇaṃ kurvanti | brūhi bhagavān vajraguruḥ śāstā
vajragurur āha | sādhu sādhu mahāsattva śrītattvasaṅgrahā dau mūlatantre côttaratantre ca vāyutattvaṃ na vispaṣṭenôktam | sandhyāyabhāṣitatvāt | vyākhyātantre tu yathārutena bhāṣitaṃ tad avatāryate
nāsikācchidrasambhūtaḥ pañcabuddhakulasthitaḥ
pañcavāyūrdhvasañcāro dehe carati nityaśaḥ
saṃvṛtighrāṇasañcāro dvārāt tasya viniḥsṛtaḥ
vāmadakṣiṇadvandvāś ca stabdhaś caîte caturvidhāḥ
dakṣiṇāt prasaro dhātur hutabhugmaṇḍalaṃ ca vai
raktavarṇam idaṃ vyaktaṃ padmanāthasya sañcaret
vāmāc ca prasaro dhātur vāyumaṇḍalaniḥsṛtaḥ
haritaśyāmasaṅkāśaṃ karmanāthasya sañcaret
dvandvasya prasaro dhātuḥ kanakavarṇasannibhaḥ
māhendramaṇḍalaṃ caîva ratnanāthasya sañcaret
stabdho na prasaro dhātuḥ kṣaṇād vāruṇamaṇḍalam
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ vajranāthasya sañcaret
sarvadhātūn samuddhṛtya hy ādhārādheyadhāritaḥ
vairocanamahākāyo maraṇānte viniścaret
caturmaṇḍalam etadd hi japen nityaṃ samāhitaḥ
ahorātraṃ sadā jāpyo mantriṇāṃ japasaṅkhyayā
ity uktaṃ bhagavatā vajramālāmahāyogatantre | asyāyam arthaḥ | vajrapadmayor nāsikābhyāṃ raśmiṃ viniścaret | ūrdhvagataḥ saṃvṛtināsāgrād vāmadakṣiṇadvandvastabdhakrameṇa niścarati
tatrâyaṃ kramaḥ | vāmaghrāṇād vinirgato vāyur amoghasiddhis tathāgataḥ | vāyusvabhāvo vāyavyamaṇḍalaṃ haritaśyāmaraśmisvarūpam iti | dakṣiṇaghrāṇāt sañcarito vāyur amitābhas tathāgataḥ | tejaḥsvabhāvo 'gnimaṇḍalaṃ raktaraśmisvabhāvam | ghrāṇadvandvād vinirgato vāyū ratnasambhavo māhendramaṇḍalaṃ pītaraśmisvabhāvam | stabdho mandapracāro vāyur akṣobhyaḥ | svacchābdhatusvabhāvo vāruṇamaṇḍalaṃ śvetaraśmisvabhāvam | catvāri dhātumaṇḍalāni vyāno vyāpto vāyur na niścarati raśmiḥ śrīvairocanas tathāgataḥ khasamasvabhāvaḥ
kintv ekaiko raśmir viniścaret | pañcapañcaraśmir vinirgacchati | ekena dhātumaṇḍalena catvāro dhātavo vyāptā iti | ekaikasminn api maṇḍale tryakṣaramantrādhipatiḥ praveśādikrameṇa svayam eva satataṃ japed iti | saṅkṣepato vāyutattvam uktaṃ
vajraśiṣya uvāca | gurupādaprasādād vāyutattvam āgamādhigamābhyāṃ suśikṣito 'ham | adhunā mantratattvasya lakṣaṇaṃ jñātum icchāmi | anukampām upādāya nirdiśatu bhagavān vajraguruḥ śāstā
vajragurur āha | sādhu sādhu mahāsattva mantratattvaṃ nāma tattvasaṅgrahādau mūlatantre côttaratantre ca kevalaṃ mantramātram udīritaṃ mantroddhāro na pradarśitaḥ | vyākhyātantre tu mantroddhāro mantrasaṅketo mantrārtho mantratattvaṃ ca bhagavatā sadbhāvena vivṛtam | ato vyākhyātantram anadhigatā bāhyamantraparāyaṇā na prajānanti | tasmād yatnataḥ śṛṇu vyākhyātantrā nusāreṇa mantratattvaṃ te pratibodhayāmi
tatra sarpādimantrā ālikālisamudbhavāḥ | teṣāṃ tattvam anāhatodbhavaṃ tryakṣaram | yasmāt sarvamantrāḥ strīpunnapuṃsakasvabhāvā yathālabdhopadeśena tryakṣare praviśanti | tena tryakṣaraḥ sarvamantrādhipatiḥ | te ca punar ekaikaśo 'nāhatena saha tribhis tribhir akṣarair niṣpannāḥ
adhunā 'kṣaratrayasya vyāpāro nirdiśyate | tatra tāvat trisaṃyogād devatāmūrtiṃ niṣpādayati | sa eva praveśasthitivyutthānakrameṇa deham aharniśaṃ dhārayati | sa evâlikālibhiḥ saha dvayendriyasamāpattikāle 'dhomukho bhūtvā guhyanāsikācchidrāc chukrarūpeṇa vinirgatya sattvadhātūn utpādayati | sa eva prāṇāyāmena saha punar ūrdhvaṃ gatvā indriyadvāraṃ prabodhya saṃvṛtighrāṇa- dvārād vāmadakṣiṇādikrameṇa nirgatyânābhogena vajrajāpaṃ kṛtvā pūrvakarmāvaraṇaṃ viśodhayati | sa evâhorātrakrameṇa japasaṅkhyām upalakṣya vāruṇādimaṇḍalodaye sitādivarṇam āśritya śāntikādisarvakarmāṇi karoti | sa evâkṣararūpeṇa parikalpito nâbhiṣpanditajihvāgrêtyādivāgjāpalakṣaṇena jāpaṃ kṛtvā bāhyavarṇādikriyām āśritya śāntikādisarvakarmāṇi karoti | sa eva tryakṣaraśodhanabodhanajvalanakrameṇâhāraṃ viśodhya nirāmayaṃ karoti | evaṃ kaḍevarāvasthāyāṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā paryante 'nāhate praviśya punar api prākṛtadeham āśritya tathaîva sarvaṃ karoti
idānīṃ tryakṣarotpattim āha | bhagavān sandhyāvyākaraṇamahāyogatantre
ekādir navamadhye tu daśabhir yo na badhyate
tam abaddhaṃ vijānīyāt sa vetti paramaṃ padam
svaravyañjanavarṇāś ca navasaṅkhyānuvartinaḥ
abaddhânyonyasaṃyogād yo vetti sa jagadguruḥ
yo buddhvā vāñchayet siddhiṃ vimuktiphalasampadam
sa tad eva samāpnoti arūpād rūpavarjitam
bhūtāntena samāyuktaṃ kalādiṣoḍaśe sthitam
pañcapañcakasaṃyuktaṃ catustrayaniyojitam
sānusvāraṃ sadīrghaṃ ca guṇasaṃyogalopavat
hrasvaṃ samastavākyaṃ syān na cânekaṃ na caîkakam
yakārārthena yat kiñcit kartavyaṃ siddhim icchatā
rephāditritayenaîva jagatkāryaṃ pravartate
ye varṇāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ proktā abhimukhāś ca ye punaḥ
strīpunnapuṃsakās te ca dhātvādiparikalpitāḥ
adhaūrdhvasamāyuktā jñātvā buddhyā niyojitāḥ
ṣaḍbhir uktaṃ catustryaikān niḥsvabhāvaikabhāvajām
tān yādyarthe samāyojya tryadhvajñānaṃ tu jāyate
svapnendrajālavad vidvān kuryāj jagat tridhātuke
pravyāhāram idaṃ mantraṃ niḥsvabhāvasvabhāvajam
tataḥ pariṇataṃ rūpaṃ yad devatopalambhakam
sāṅketikaṃ tritattvasthaṃ prakṛtijāpalakṣaṇam
anākhyeyam anuccāryaṃ bodhicittam idaṃ param
tad eva tritayaikaṃ syād anirgamam anāgamam
anirodhaṃ praśāntaṃ ca śāśvatocchedavarjitam
tryadhvavidākṛtasaṅkalpam ākāśābhedalakṣaṇam
pāramārthikam evêdaṃ pratyātmavedyalakṣaṇam
sarvāsv api kriyāsv eva niṣadyādiṣu yogavit
anākhyeyam anuccāryaṃ tryadhvātītaṃ japet sadā
pāṇḍarādijapaḥ proktaḥ pañcaviṃśacchatadvayam
caturbhir guṇitaṃ samyak caturyogaṃ śataṃ nava
navaśataṃ tu yad dṛṣṭaṃ caturviṃśatiparikramaiḥ
pratyutpādād bhavet tac ca dvyayutaṃ śataṣoḍaśam
tad itthaṃ guhyasandhyāyāṃ sūkṣmayogaṃ prakāśitam
dhyānādhyayanavītaṃ tu tathâpi japa ucyate
ity adhyātmamantratattvam ucyate
vajraśiṣya uvāca | ādhyātmikavāgakṣarapravṛttikāraṇe 'pagatasaṃśayaḥ | api ca hrasvaṃ samastavākyaṃ syād ity uktaṃ bhagavatā tat kathaṃ hrasvo 'kāraḥ samastavākpravṛtteḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavati
vajragurur āha | sādhu sādhu mahāsattva | iha prāvacanikā vyākaraṇaṃ puraskṛtya kevalaśabdārthamātram anusmaranti | na tu punar akṣaram abhilāpaś ca kutra kasmāt kathaṃ pravartata iti | yathābhūtākṣaratattvaṃ na prajānanti buddhagocaratvāt | śṛṇu deśanānusāreṇa te pratibodhayāmi
śabdas tāvad ālikālimayaḥ | ālîty akārādiṣoḍaśasvarāḥ | kālîti kakārādivarṇās trayastriṃśat | ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktam ekonapañcāśallipikaṃ sarvam astavyastasamastasvaravyañjanabinduvisargasaṃhitādhātuvibhaktisamāsapadavigrahastrīliṅgatiṅantakṛttaddhitapratyayādibhir bhāṣyaparyantaṃ vyākaraṇam iti nāma saṅketakena paribhāṣaṇena jñāyate | atas tasya padavākyacchandovṛttaślokagāthādaṇḍakādibhiś caturaśītisāhasradharmaskandhasūtrāntatantrakalpatripiṭakakāvyanāṭakādayo laukikalokottaraśāstrāṇi sambhavanti | śāstram āśritya sarvasiddhayaḥ sampadyante | yathôktaṃ bhagavatā laṅkāvatārasūtre
tadyathā mahāmate kaścid eva puruṣaḥ pradīpaṃ gṛhya dhanam anveṣayati | evam eva mahāmate vāgvikalparutapradīpena bodhisattvā mahāsattvā vāgvikalparahitāṃ svapratyātmagatim anupraviśantîti
kintu teṣāṃ padavākyādigatavarṇaviśeṣāṇāṃ vijñānabhūto 'yam akāraḥ | yasmād akārasvaraviyuktā na santi kakārādayo varṇāḥ | halantatvān na bhavanti vācyāḥ | yathôktaṃ bhagavatā nāmasaṅgītikāyām
akāraḥ sarvavarṇāgryo mahārthaḥ paramākṣaraḥ
mahāprāṇo hy anutpādo vāgudāhāravarjitaḥ
sarvābhilāpahetvagryaḥ sarvavāksuprabhāsvara iti
tenôktaṃ bhagavatā sakaladhyānamukhabījapadam | akāro mukhaṃ sarvadharmāṇām ādyanutpannatvād iti | sahajākṣaraṃ tu punar ucyate | vajramaṇḍalālaṅkāratantre 'py akāraṃ dyotayann āha
jvalantaṃ dīpasadṛśaṃ hṛdi madhyam anāhatam
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ sūkṣmam akāraṃ paramaṃ prabhum iti
evaṃ sarvatathāgatā akārānvayam akārahetubhūtam akāranirjātam uccaritapradhvansisvabhāvaṃ vāgvikalpalakṣaṇaṃ yathā- bhūtaṃ jñātvā śabdāpaśabdanirapekṣaṃ sattvāśayānuśayabhedena vineyajanebhyo dharmaṃ deśayantîti
ata evôktaṃ bhagavatā laṅkāvatārasūtre
arthapratiśaraṇena mahāmate bodhisattvena mahāsattvena bhavitavyaṃ | na vyañjanapratiśaraṇena | vyañjanānusārī mahāmate kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā svam ātmānaṃ ca nāśayati | paramārthaṃ ca paraṃ nâvabodhayati
tadyathā mahāmate aṅgulyā kaścit kasyacit kiñcid darśayet | sa câpy aṅgulyagram eva pratisared vīkṣitum | evam eva mahāmate bālajātīyā iva bālapṛthagjanavargā yathārutāṅgulyagrābhiniveśābhiniviṣṭā evaṃ kālaṃ kariṣyanti | na yathārutāṅgulyagrārthaṃ hitvā paramārtham anveṣayanti
tasmād arthakāmena te sevanīyāḥ | ato viparītā ye yathārutārthābhiniviṣṭās te varjanīyā arthānveṣiṇêti
vākpravṛttir api caturvidhêty uktaṃ bhagavatā atraîva sūtre
caturvidhaṃ mahāmate vāgvikalpalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | yad uta lakṣaṇavāk svapnavāk dauṣṭhulyābhiniveśavāk | anādikālavikalpavāk | tatra mahāmate lakṣaṇavāk svavikalparūpanimittābhiniveśāt pravartate | svapnavāk punar mahāmate pūrvānubhūtaviṣayānusmaraṇāt pratinibaddhaviṣayābhāvāc ca pravartate | dauṣṭhulyavikalpābhiniveśavāk punar mahāmate sattvapūrvakṛtakarmānusmaraṇāt pravartate | anādikālavikalpavāk punar mahāmate anādikālaprapañcābhiniveśadauṣṭhulyasvabījavāsanātaḥ pravartate | etadd hi mahāmate caturvidhaṃ vāgvikalpalakṣaṇam iti
anena nyāyena śabdo 'kārodbhavatvād akṣaraḥ | kṣaraṃ vināśo 'kṣaram avināśaḥ | khasamasvabhāvaṃ yac chabdadvāreṇa pratipādyate | niṣpannakramaṃ tad apy akṛtakam anādinidhanasvabhāvam iti | yathôktam ekanayanirdeśasūtre
dharmā ime śabdarutena vyākṛtā dharmāś ca śabdaś ca hi nâtra labhyate
nayaikatāṃ câpy avatīrya dharmatām anuttarāṃ kṣāntivarāṃ spṛśiṣyata iti
yathôktaṃ vairocanābhisambodhicaryātantre
api tu guhyakādhipate mantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvabuddhair na kṛtaṃ na kāritaṃ nânumoditam
tat kasya hetoḥ | eṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ dharmatā yad uta utpādād vā tathāgatānām anutpādād vā tathāgatānāṃ sthitaîvaîṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ dharmatā yad uta mantrāṇāṃ mantradharmatā
tatra guhyakādhipate 'sti kāmadhātvīśvarasya madayantikā nāma vidyā | tayā sarvān kāmāvacarān devaputrān madena mūrcchayati | vividhavicitraramaṇīyāṃś ca pradeśān darśayati | vividhavicitraparibhogāṃś câbhinirmāya paranirmitavaśavartibhyo devebhyaḥ prayacchaty ātmanā ca paribhuṅkte
tadyathâsti maheśvarasya devaputrasya manojavā nāma vidyā | tayā trisāhasramahāsāhasre lokadhātau sarvakāryaṃ karoti | sarvopabhogaparibhogāṃś câbhinirmāya śuddhāvāsakāyikebhyo devebhyaḥ prayacchaty ātmanā ca paribhuṅkte
tadyathā māhendrajāliko mantrair vividhavicitrārthān manuṣyādikān darśayati | tadyathâpi nāma mantrair māyāṃ darśayati | tadyathâpi nāma mantrair viṣam apanayati jvarādikaṃ ca | tadyathâpi nāma mantrakalpikā devatā mantraiḥ śreyaḥ sattvebhyaḥ prayacchati | tadyathâpi nāma mantrair agner uṣṇatā naśyati śītatā ca sambhavati
ebhir nidarśanapadair mantraprabhāvo 'bhiśraddhātavya iti | sa ca mantraprabhāvo hi na mantrato niṣkrāmati | na sattveṣu praviśati | na prayoktṛta upalabhyate | atha ca kulaputra mantrādhiṣṭhānadharmatā sambhavaṃ nâtikrāmati | kālatrayātītatvāt | sarvathâcintyapratītyasamutpādābhinivartitatvāc ca
tasmāt tarhi kulaputrâcintyadharmatāsvabhāvagatiṅgatena satatasamitaṃ mantranayo 'nugantavya iti
evam ādhyātmikabāhyamaṇimantrauṣadhīnām acintyaprabhāvam āgamādhigamābhyāṃ pratipādya | idānīṃ niṣpannāniṣpannasattvadhātūnāṃ yathābhūtavāgviśuddhiṃ darśayann āha | kinnararājaparipṛcchāsūtre
kutaḥ punaḥ kinnarādhipate sarvasattvānāṃ rutaghoṣā niścaranti
āha | ākāśāt kulaputra sarvasattvānāṃ rutaghoṣā niścaranti
āha | na punaḥ kinnarādhipate adhyātmikakoṣṭhāt sarvasattvānāṃ rutaghoṣā niścaranti
āha | tat kiṃ manyase kulaputra kāyābhyantarakoṣṭhāt sarvasattvānāṃ rutaghoṣā niścaranti | āhosvic cittāt
āha | kinnarādhipate na kāyān na cittāt | tat kasmādd hetoḥ | kāyo hi jaḍo niśceṣṭas tṛṇakuḍyakāṣṭhapratibhāsopamaḥ | cittaṃ câpy anidarśanaṃ māyopamam apratigham avijñaptikam
āha | kāyacittavinirmuktāni punaḥ kulaputra kuto 'nyato rutāni niścaranti
āha | ākāśād amanaskārāt sambhavati kinnarādhipate sarvasattvānāṃ rutavijñaptiḥ
āha | tat kiṃ manyase kulaputra yady ākāśaṃ na bhavet kuto rutāni niścareyuḥ
āha | nâkāśavinirmuktaḥ kinnarādhipate kaścid rutaniścāraḥ
āha | ) tad anena te kulaputra paryāyeṇaîvaṃ veditavyam | ye kecid rutavyāpārā niścaranti | sarve te ākāśān niścarantîti | ākāśasvabhāvāni hi rutāni samanantaraniryātāni ca niruddhyante | niruddhāni câkāśasvabhāvatāyām eva santiṣṭhante

verses.meaningZh: 出自《Caryāmelāpakapradīpa (Guhyasamāja Tantric Treatise on Kāya-Vāk-Citta-Viveka & Mantratattva)》(Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.074)，写本叶码：[A:19b]。

verses.iast: adhunā 'kṣaratrayasya vyāpāro nirdiśyate | tatra tāvat trisaṃyogād devatāmūrtiṃ niṣpādayati | sa eva praveśasthitivyutthānakrameṇa deham aharniśaṃ dhārayati | sa evâlikālibhiḥ saha dvayendriyasamāpattikāle 'dhomukho bhūtvā guhyanāsikācchidrāc chukrarūpeṇa vinirgatya sattvadhātūn utpādayati | sa eva prāṇāyāmena saha punar ūrdhvaṃ gatvā indriyadvāraṃ prabodhya saṃvṛtighrāṇa- dvārād vāmadakṣiṇādikrameṇa nirgatyânābhogena vajrajāpaṃ kṛtvā pūrvakarmāvaraṇaṃ viśodhayati | sa evâhorātrakrameṇa japasaṅkhyām upalakṣya vāruṇādimaṇḍalodaye sitādivarṇam āśritya śāntikādisarvakarmāṇi karoti | sa evâkṣararūpeṇa parikalpito nâbhiṣpanditajihvāgrêtyādivāgjāpalakṣaṇena jāpaṃ kṛtvā bāhyavarṇādikriyām āśritya śāntikādisarvakarmāṇi karoti | sa eva tryakṣaraśodhanabodhanajvalanakrameṇâhāraṃ viśodhya nirāmayaṃ karoti | evaṃ kaḍevarāvasthāyāṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā paryante 'nāhate praviśya punar api prākṛtadeham āśritya tathaîva sarvaṃ karoti

nanu prayojanaviśeṣārthitaiva puṃsaḥ prayojanaviśeṣasaṃśayotpattihetuḥ prāgvidyata eva | tathāhi prayojanaviśeṣākāṅkṣāparigatamanasaḥ prathamataramevaṃ bhavatyeva, kimidamasmadadhi gataprayojanena saprayojanam ? āhosvidanyena ? kiṃ vā niṣprayojanamiti; tatsādhaka bādhakapramāṇābhāve tasya nyāyaprāptatvāt | prayojanaviśeṣapratipādakaśāstrāntaropala bdheśca | ato bhavatyeva prāgapi prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasaṃśaya iti vyarthaḥ prayojanavākyo panyāsaḥ | naitadasti | yadyapi prayojanaviśeṣārthitāpi saṃśayaviśeṣaheturbhavati | ta thāpi na sā sarveṣāṃ saṃmukhībhavati | avyutpannapuruṣārthānāṃ mūḍhadhiyāṃ keṣāṃcidasaṃmu khībhāvāt | tathāhi—mokṣaḥ paramapuruṣārthatayā siddhaḥ, atha ca santi kecidavyu tpannā ye tamapi paramapuruṣārthaṃ puruṣārthatayā na jānanti | prāgye na taṃ prārthayiṣyante te | na vā saṃmukhībhūtā prayojanaviśeṣākāṅkṣā prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasandehotpattihetu ryuktā, kāraṇasattādhīnatvātkāryāṇām | yadi nāma sā keṣāṃcidapi saṃmukhībhavati, tathāpyasau sādhanāntaraparityāgena pratiniyatasādhanopādānahetoḥ saṃśayaviśeṣasya heturna bhavati; sarvatra sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvena tasyāstaddhetutvena nyāyaprāptatvāt | na cai tāvanmātreṇa pravṛttiryuktā | sarvatra pravṛttiprasaṅgāt | na ca śakyaṃ kenacitsarvatra pravartti tumityataḥ phalaviśeṣārthino'pi pratiniyatasādhanaparigrahanibandhanābhāvādudāsīran | tasmātpratiniyatasādhanaparigrahahetuprayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasaṃśayotpādanāyātyantaparokṣārtha viṣayāgamapraṇayanavat phalaviśeṣārthinā pratiniyatasādhanaparigrahāyābhidhānīyameva prayo janavākyam | tathā hi tenāsyaiva śāstrasyārthaviśeṣa upadarśyate nānyasya | ato'nena pratiniyatasādhanasādhyaphalaviśeṣaviṣayaḥ saṃśayo janyate | sa ca śrotā kadācinma māyamarthaviśeṣo niṣpatsyata iti prayojanavākyopajanitāt prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayādatya ntaparokṣārthaviṣayāgamopajanitādiva saṃśayātpravarttetāpītyataḥ prayojanavākyopanyāsaḥ
avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam, anyathā'tyantaparokṣārthaviṣayāgamapraṇayanamapi vyarthaṃ syāt; prāgapyāgamapraṇayanāddānādiṣu phalaviśeṣārthināṃ sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvena ta tsaṃśayasya vidyamānatvāt | kiṃ tvasāvavyutpannasvargādiphalānāṃ naivotpadyate | tatkāra ṇabhūtāyāḥ phalaviśeṣārthitāyā asaṃmukhībhāvāt | yeṣāṃ copajāyate teṣāmapi sarva tropalādibhakṣaṇe'pi pravṛttihetutayā sādhāraṇatvādupalādibhakṣaṇaparihāreṇa (na) prati niyatadānādiparigrahaheturbhavatīti matvā tadarthamāgamapraṇetṛbhirāgamaḥ praṇīyate tadvatprayo janavākyamapi śāstrakārairityacodyametat | na cāpi jijñāsitaprayojanaviśeṣapratipādakaṃ śāstrāntaramupalabdham, yena tadupalabdhibalādabhimataprayojanaviśeṣaviṣayaḥ sandeho bha vet | na hyabhimataprayojanaviśeṣasādhane śāstrāntare sambhavati kaścitprekṣāvān paraṃ śā strāntaramārabhate | prekṣāvattvahāniprasaṅgāt | ato na śāstrāntaropalabdhirapi vivakṣi taprayojanaviśeṣasandehaheturbhavati | tasmācchrotṛjanapravṛttyarthaḥ prayojanādivākyopanyāsa iti sthitam
yastu manyate na śrotṛjanapravṛttyarthaṃ prayojanādikathanam, tataḥ saṃśayotpatteḥ; saṃ śayena tu prekṣāvataḥ pravṛttyasambhavāt | kiṃtu yatprayojanarahitamanarthakaṃ vā tannārabdha vyam, yathā kākadantaparīkṣonmattādivākyam; prayojanarahitaṃ cedaṃ śāstramato na śrotuṃ karttuṃ vā prārabdhavyamityevaṃ vyāpakānupalabdhyā yaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate tasya hetorasiddhatodbhā vanārthamādau prayojanādivākyopanyāsa iti | tadasamyagiva lakṣyate | saṃśayenāpi pravṛtteḥ prasādhitatvāt | asiddhatodbhāvanasya ca vaiyarthyāt | evaṃ hi tadarthavadbhavet | yadi tasya parasyāto vākyātpravṛttirbhavet | yāvatodbhāvitāyāmapyanena vākyenāsiddha tāyāṃ nāto vākyātprekṣāvato yathoktavyāpakāttatvaniścayaḥ samutpadyate yenāsau prava rttito bhavet | pūrvavadvākyasyāsyāpramāṇatvāt | saṃśayena ca prekṣāpūrvakāriṇo bhavanma tena pravṛttyasambhavāt | ato viphalamevāsiddhatodbhāvanam | nāpi kaścitprekṣāvānavi ditaśāstraśarīro'kasmādvyāpakābhāvaṃ niścityānena pratyavatiṣṭhate | nāpi tatpratyavasthā nāt svayaṃ viditaśāstraprayojano'pi śāstrakṛnnārabheta kartuṃ śrotā vā prekṣāpūrvakārī nirnibandhanādvākyānnivarttate yena tayoḥ pravṛttyarthamasiddhatodbhāvanaṃ syāt | athāpi syādyo'prekṣāpūrvakārī so'nibandhanamakasmādapi yathoktavyāpakābhāvaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | paraiśca grāhayedapi, atastaṃ pratyasiddhatodbhāvanaṃ kriyata ityetadapyayuktam

kecit punaridaṃ dharmottarīyaṃ vākyamanyathā vyācakṣate | nātra prayojanaśabdena phalamabhipretaṃ kintu prayujyate pravarttyate'neneti, prayojayatīti vā prayojanam | tacca puruṣārthasiddhihetutvam | abhidheyasya hi samyagjñānasya puruṣārthasiddhihetutvena prayuktaḥ puruṣaḥ pravarttata iti | uttaratrāpi prayojanamidameva vivakṣitam | ata eva-- atra ce tyādivākye sarvapuruṣārthasiddhihetutvaṃ prayojanaṃ pravarttaka mukta miti spaṣṭīkaraṇaṃ ghaṭata iti | tacca nātiśliṣṭamutpaśyāmaḥ | tathā hi atra ca prakaraṇābhidheyasya samyagjñānasya puruṣārthasiddhihetutvaṃ prayojanamukta miti vakṣyamāṇena vyaktīkṛtatvādihāpi abhidheya sya prayojanam iti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo'vaśyakāryaḥ | tathā cāya masamarthaḥ padavidhirbhavet | taddhi puruṣārthasiddhihetutvaṃ nābhidheyasya samyagjñānasya pravarttakamapi tu puruṣasya | tat kathamabhidheyapadena samasyeta prayojanapadam ? na ca kenacidrūpeṇābhidheyasambandhi tva'sya samarthayorekārthībhāvo bhavatīti | na hi yajñadattaputro bhṛtyatvādinā rūpeṇa devadatta sambandhī bhavandevadattaputra iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya viṣayo bhavitumarhati
atha bhāvapradhānatvānnirdeśasya prayojanaṃ prayojakatvamityarthaḥ | taccāśritasya prayojakatayā bhavati sambandhīti samarthavidhiḥ kalpyate

evamabhidhāya prayojanaṃ sakalaprakaraṇārthasaṃgrāhakaṃ ślokamāha asādhanāṅvacana 1b1 mityādinā | asādhanāṅgavacanamadoṣodbhāvanañca dvayorvādiprativādi noryathākramaṃ nigrahasthānaṃ parājayādhikaraṇaṃ | anyattvityeta ddheyavyatiriktama kṣapādapa rikalpitaṃ pratijñāsaṃnyāsādikaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ nigrahasthānaṃ na yuktamiti kṛtvā neṣyate | nigrahasthānamiti varttate | ayaṃ tāvat sa māsena ślokārthaḥ | iṣṭasye 1b1 tyādinā vibhāgamārabhate | iṣṭo'rtho'nittyaḥ śabda ityādi sādhyattvenepsitaḥ | tasya siddhiḥ pratipattiḥ sādhanaṃ | tadanena bhāvasya sādhanoyaṃ sādhanaśabdastāvadasminvyākhyāne'bhipreto na tu karaṇasādhana iti darśayati | tasya sādhanasyeṣṭārthasiddhilakṣaṇamasyāṅgaṃ kintadityāha | nirvarttakaṃ janakaṃ | ane nāṅgaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe | kāraṇaparyāyoyamatrāṅgaśabdo nāvayavaparyāya ityarthaḥ | tacca sādhanāṅgamiha niścitatrairūpyaṃ liṅgamucyate | asya sādhanāṅgasya vacanaṃ trirūpaliṅgā khyānaṃ | tasya sādhanāṅgasyāvacanamanuccāraṇama 1b2 nabhidhānaṃ yattadasādhanāṅgavacanaṃ | anenaitatkathayati asādhanāṅgasya pakṣopanayanā dervacanamasādhanāṅgavacanamiti nai va pratipattavyamasminvyākhyāne | kintu sādhanāṅga syaivāvacanamasādhanāṅgavacanamiti | tadasādhanāṅgavacanaṃ vādino nigrahasthānaṃ | tadetena ślokasya pūrvvabhāgamvivṛṇoti | kathampunaḥ sādhanāṅgasyānuccāraṇambhavati nigrahasthānaṃ cetyāha | tadabhyupagamyeti 1b2 taditīṣṭaṃ sādhyamabhyupagamyāha metatsādhayāmīti pratijñayāpratibhayā karaṇa bhūtayā tūṣṇīmbhāvāt | apratibhā'tra pūrvvādhigatārthavismaraṇaṃ stambhitattvañca gṛhyate
anena sarvvathā sādhanāṅgasyāvacanamāha abhidhāne vā yadi na samarthitaṃ tadokta mapya' nūktameva svakāryākaraṇāt | ityabhiprāyavānāha — sādhanāṅgasyā samarthanādveti 1b2 | tadabhyupagamyetivartate | vā śabdaḥ purvvāpekṣayā vikalpārthaḥ | sādhanā ṅgasyāsamarthanaṃ triṣvapi rūpeṣu niścayāpradarśanaṃ | tasmāttū ṣṇīmbhāvādasamarthanācca sādhanāṅgasyānuccāraṇaṃ | tataśca pratijñātārthākāraṇāt vādino nigrahādhikaraṇa miti 1b2 prakṛtena sambandhaḥ | kvacittu vādina iti pāṭhaḥ | tatra tacchabdena prakṛtamanuccāraṇaṃ saṃbadhyate
kathampunaḥ sādhanāṅgāsamarthanambha vati | yena tadviparyayenāsamarthanātprati jñātārthākāraṇādvādino nigrahādhikaraṇattvamiti kadācitkaścid brūyādityetatpari jihīrṣurādiprasthānamāracayati trividhameve 1b2 tyādinā triprakārameva liṅga maṅgaṅkaraṇaṃ kasyāsiddheḥ pratipattirūpāyāḥ | kasya siddherityāha | apratya kṣasyā parokṣasyānumeyabhūtasya vastuna iti yāvat | avadhāraṇañcaturādi vyavacchedamācaṣṭe | trividhameveti niyamaḥ kathamayamiti cet | yasmādvidhi pratiṣedharūpatayā dvidhā sādhyaṃ vyavasthitaṃ | vidhirūpañca sadbhā varūpaṅkāraṇarū pamvā bhavad bhavet | nānyat | tatra hetoḥ pratibandhāyogāt | nahyarthāntarasyākā ryasya sadbhāve'parasya sadbhāvo yuktaḥ | paṭasadbhāva ivoṣṭrasya | nāpyarthāṃ tarasyākāraṇasya nivṛttāvakāryasyānyasya ca nivṛttiryuktimatī | uṣṭre nivṛttāviva paṭasya | na cānvayavyatirekavikalasyāgamakattvaṃ yuktaṃ | paṭasyāpyuṣṭragamakattva prasaṅgāt | svabhāvabhūtadharmasadbhāve tu svabhāvabhūtasyānyasya sadbhāvo yukto nahi svabhāvaḥ svambhāvamparityajya vartte | tatsvabhāvattvābhāvaprasaṅgāt | tannivṛttau ca nivṛ ttiḥ | kāryasyāpi bhāve kāraṇasya bhāvo yuktaḥ | tannivṛttau ca nivṛttiranyathā tena vināpi bhāvātkāryameva tattasya na syāttadanyavat | tasmātsvabhāva kāraṇabhūtasādhyabhedāt | dvidhaiva vidhirūpaṃ sādhyaṃ tatraiva hetoḥ pratibandhāt | svabhāvabhūtañca sādhyaṃ svabhāvahetuḥ sādhayati | kāraṇabhūtañca kāryahetu rityabhyupeyaṃ | pratiṣedhamapyupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalabdhireva sādhayati | nānyā yathā tathā vistareṇa pratipādayiṣyati | tadidamiha saṃkṣiptamartha tattvaṃ viṣayavyapekṣayā viṣayiṇo liṃgasya vyavasthā | viṣayaśca vidhiḥ pratiṣedho vā bhavet | vidhāvapyarthāntaramvā vidhīye tānarthāntaraṃ vā arthāntaravidhāvapi kā ryakāraṇamanubhayamvā sādhyate | kāryapratipādanepi kāraṇasāmānyamvā'meghādi vyāvṛttaṃ vastumātraṃ liṅgatvenocyate | kāraṇaviśeṣo vā yo'prati baddhasāmarthye me ghādiḥ | pratiṣedhopi niṣedhyābhimatasyānupalambhenopalambhena vā pratipādyeta | anupalambhepi upalambhanivṛttimātralakṣaṇo vā bhavet | tattulyayogāvastha ḥ kevalā parapadārthopalambharūpo veti vikalpāḥ | tatra nāvaśyaṃ gambhīradhvānādiyuktamapi meghādikāraṇamātraṃ vṛṣṭyādikāryāvirbhāvaka mantarā pratibandhasambhavena vya bhicārāt | ato na kāraṇamātraṃ gamakaṃ | kāraṇa viśeṣādapyapratihataśakteranantaraṃ sambandhasmṛtivyavahitādanumeyavijñānātprāk kāryamevodbhūtamakṣajñānagrāhyaṃ bhavatīti na tasyāpi liṅgatvaṃ | kāryantu kāraṇa liṅgaṃ yuktaṃ | tadavinābhāvāt | tadatikrame vā hetumattāmvilaṃghayet | anubhayamapya sambandhānugamakamatiprasaṅgo vā | anarthāntaramapyavyabhicārāṅgamyata iti yukti mat | niṣedhopyupalambhena na yujyate virodhāt | kathaṃ hi nāmopalabhyate ca nāsti cetyupapadyate | tajjñāna nivṛttimātramapi vyabhicāri | ekajñānasaṃsargiṇastu kaivalya dṛṣṭerasattāvyavahāro yukto yadi hi syādupalabhya sattva eva bhavet | pramāṇañca yada nupapadya mānaviṣayaṃ na tadviṣayi yuktaṃ | yathā vājiviṣāṇaṃ | anupapadyamānaviṣaya ñcoktaprakāreṇa svabhāvādi syādanyasaṃyogyādiparaparikalpitaṃ liṃ gamiti vyāpa kānupalambhaḥ | vaidharmyeṇa nīlādijñānaṃ | tadeva vā kāryādiliṅgaṃ | naimittikaśabdā rthānupapattirbādhikā | kimevaṃ siddhamagamakattvamanyeṣāṃ | tathāhi viṣa yitvaṅga makattvaṃ prakāśakattvamityādayaḥ paryāyāḥ | tasmātsādhyasya trividhattvāttaṅgamako heturapi trividha eveti sthitametat

bhāvātkāryameva tattasya na syāttadanyavat | tasmātsvabhāva kāraṇabhūtasādhyabhedāt | dvidhaiva vidhirūpaṃ sādhyaṃ tatraiva hetoḥ pratibandhāt | svabhāvabhūtañca sādhyaṃ svabhāvahetuḥ sādhayati | kāraṇabhūtañca kāryahetu rityabhyupeyaṃ | pratiṣedhamapyupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalabdhireva sādhayati | nānyā yathā tathā vistareṇa pratipādayiṣyati | tadidamiha saṃkṣiptamartha tattvaṃ viṣayavyapekṣayā viṣayiṇo liṃgasya vyavasthā | viṣayaśca vidhiḥ pratiṣedho vā bhavet | vidhāvapyarthāntaramvā vidhīye tānarthāntaraṃ vā arthāntaravidhāvapi kā ryakāraṇamanubhayamvā sādhyate | kāryapratipādanepi kāraṇasāmānyamvā'meghādi vyāvṛttaṃ vastumātraṃ liṅgatvenocyate | kāraṇaviśeṣo vā yo'prati baddhasāmarthye me ghādiḥ | pratiṣedhopi niṣedhyābhimatasyānupalambhenopalambhena vā pratipādyeta | anupalambhepi upalambhanivṛttimātralakṣaṇo vā bhavet | tattulyayogāvastha ḥ kevalā parapadārthopalambharūpo veti vikalpāḥ | tatra nāvaśyaṃ gambhīradhvānādiyuktamapi meghādikāraṇamātraṃ vṛṣṭyādikāryāvirbhāvaka mantarā pratibandhasambhavena vya bhicārāt | ato na kāraṇamātraṃ gamakaṃ | kāraṇa viśeṣādapyapratihataśakteranantaraṃ sambandhasmṛtivyavahitādanumeyavijñānātprāk kāryamevodbhūtamakṣajñānagrāhyaṃ bhavatīti na tasyāpi liṅgatvaṃ | kāryantu kāraṇa liṅgaṃ yuktaṃ | tadavinābhāvāt | tadatikrame vā hetumattāmvilaṃghayet | anubhayamapya sambandhānugamakamatiprasaṅgo vā | anarthāntaramapyavyabhicārāṅgamyata iti yukti mat | niṣedhopyupalambhena na yujyate virodhāt | kathaṃ hi nāmopalabhyate ca nāsti cetyupapadyate | tajjñāna nivṛttimātramapi vyabhicāri | ekajñānasaṃsargiṇastu kaivalya dṛṣṭerasattāvyavahāro yukto yadi hi syādupalabhya sattva eva bhavet | pramāṇañca yada nupapadya mānaviṣayaṃ na tadviṣayi yuktaṃ | yathā vājiviṣāṇaṃ | anupapadyamānaviṣaya ñcoktaprakāreṇa svabhāvādi syādanyasaṃyogyādiparaparikalpitaṃ liṃ gamiti vyāpa kānupalambhaḥ | vaidharmyeṇa nīlādijñānaṃ | tadeva vā kāryādiliṅgaṃ | naimittikaśabdā rthānupapattirbādhikā | kimevaṃ siddhamagamakattvamanyeṣāṃ | tathāhi viṣa yitvaṅga makattvaṃ prakāśakattvamityādayaḥ paryāyāḥ | tasmātsādhyasya trividhattvāttaṅgamako heturapi trividha eveti sthitametat

provenance.rawSnippet: oṃ namo māṇibhadrāya | evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavāñ śrāvastyāṃ viharati sma jetavane ’nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme | atha khalu māṇibhadro mahāyakṣasenāpatir yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ | upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvaikānte ’sthāt | ekānte sthito māṇibhadro mahāyakṣasenāpatir bhagavantam etad avocat | idaṃ bhadanta mama hṛdayaṃ yaḥ kaścid bhikṣur vā bhikṣuṇī vopāsako vopāsikā vā triṣkṛtvā divase vācayiṣyati tasyāhaṃ satatānubaddho bhaviṣyāmi | sarvakāryāṇi kariṣyāmi | bhojanavastrahiraṇyasuvarṇadhanadhānyarūpyaṃ ca dāsyāmi | sarvārthaṃ cāsya kārayiṣyāmi | sarvasattvānāṃ ca mānasīkariṣyāmi | sarvacittaṃ cāsya kariṣyāmi sthāpayitvā maithunopasaṃhitaṃ sāvadyam | namo ratnatrayāya | namo māṇibhadrāya mahāyakṣasenāpataye | hili māṇibhadra hili 2 māṇibhadra | cili māṇibhadra cili 2 māṇibhadra | culu māṇibhadra culu 2 māṇibhadra | turu māṇibhadra turu 2 māṇibhadra | kuru māṇibhadra kuru 2 māṇibhadra | suru māṇibhadra suru 2 māṇibhadra | sarvārthaṃ me sādhaya svāhā | tadyathā | pūtane supūtane surūpe susumate surate supuṣye hilike hili kāli pūrṇe siddhe bhadre hili 2 svāhā | ehi koniṣke ehi soniṣke ehi goniṣke svāhā | sapta vārān parijapya siddhir bhavati | asyopacāraḥ | śuklapañcadaśyāṃ triṣkālaṃ śucinā gugguludhūpaṃ dahamānenāṣṭasahasraṃ japet | suvarṇaghaṭo labhate || || āryamāṇibhadranāmadhāraṇī samāptā || ||

provenance.rawSnippet: namo ratnatrayāya | nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya || tadyathā | oṃ jaye 2 mahājaye jayavāhini jayottari kala 2 mala 2 cala 2 hulu 2 chiṇi 2 sarvakarmāvaraṇāni mama bhagavati sahasrāvarte sarvabuddhāvalokite cakṣuḥśrotaghrāṇajihvākāyamanovijñānaviśodhani | tadyathā | oṃ suru 2 prasuru 2 bhara 2 saṃbhara 2 hara 2 smara 2 oṃ sarvabuddhādhiṣṭhite svāhā | oṃ sarvabuddhāvalokite svāhā | oṃ dharmadhātugarbhe svāhā | oṃ abhāvasvabhāvadharmāvabodhani svāhā || asyā dhāraṇyā ayam upacāraḥ | kalpasahasrasaṃcitaṃ karmāvaraṇam ekavāroccāritena parikṣayaṃ gacchati | buddhasahasrāvaropitaṃ kuśalamūlaṃ bhavati | jātiparivartena cakravartirājyaiśvaryaṃ śatasahasraṃ pratilabhate | maraṇakāle ca buddhasahasraṃ paśyati | pratidinaṃ sahasrāvartaṃ kurvann ekaviṃśatidivasena bodhisattvasaṃkhyāṃ gacchati | pariśuddheṣu buddhakṣetreṣūpapadyate | triṣkṛtvā rātrau triṣkṛtvā divasasya japet | yathepsitāni svapnāni paśyati | suvarṇavarṇatathāgataṃ paśyati | aparimitānuśaṃsā bodhisattvasaṃgītīḥ śrūyante paśyante | satatasamitaṃ manasi kartavyā || āryasahasrāvartānāmadhāraṇī parisamāptaḥ || ||

provenance.rawSnippet: [0] siddhaṃ namo ratnatrayāya | namo bhagavate buddhānām | namo bhagavate śākyamunirājāya | oṃ jvala jvala giri bhavanaṃ dīptavega mahācaṇḍahṛdayasphālani | huru huru hana hana daha daha paca paca pācaya sarvasasyanāśakanāgakulavaṃśam | dhara dhara pravaracaṇḍavega mahābalaparākrama sphūrjitaraudravaktra | matha matha jvālāmālādhāriṇi caṇḍavegavati pravaravimānadhāraṇi hūṃ hūṃ balavati vegavati visara visara visaranti sarvasasyatṛṇagulmoṣadhivanaspatipuṣpaphalapatrasaṃdhāraṇi | apasarantu sarvanāgadoṣāḥ | sarvabhavanavigatavegavati svāhā | hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ | nāgavidāriṇi phaṭ | jvālāmālini phaṭ svāhā | namo buddhasya | ili mili caṇḍo micili caṇḍa caṇḍa caṇḍe bandhaya svāhā | namo bhagavate śākyamunaye tathāgatāya | namo agastyāya maharṣaye | tadyathā | kṛmi | cūri | cameli | vara vara | he vila | bandhani nāśani | daha daha | sumuri | cari | sarvaduṣṭabandhane tuṇḍabandhani sarvasaraṇi | kṣa kṣa kṣa | maṇi | kṣariṣi vasari | phuli phuṭi phuṭi samariṭi | sarantu sarvapāpaprāṇajāḥ | kṣadhili svāhā | ghumuru cale svāhā | tadyathā | oṃ vipulapravare | nāge mahānāge nāgahṛdayāvarte | jvala jvala sarvanāgahṛdayāni | kimi kimi | nāgakulavidhvaṃsani | hana hana sarvaduṣṭanāgahṛdayāni | daha daha sarvanāgabhavanāni | paca paca pācaya pācaya sarvaduṣṭanāgānām | ākrama ākrama sarvasamudrasāgaravimalavikrame mahānāgatejavare svāhā | tadyathā | oṃ caṭa caṭa vicaṭa vicaṭa śletha śletha śavari ciṭi svāhā |

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §3】Chi: Dharmacandra 法月 (738CE) T.252 849a5 - 849b19：(7)如是我聞。一時佛在王舍大城靈鷲山中。與(8)大比丘衆滿百千人。菩薩摩訶薩七萬七千(9)人倶。其名曰觀世音菩薩。文殊師利菩薩。彌(10)勒菩薩等。以爲上首。皆得三昧總持。 | 藏本 (Tib: Vimalamitra and Rin chen sde, Kg 21, shes phyin sna tshogs, ka 144b6 - 146a2-3)：’di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na | bcom ldan ’das rgyal po’i khab na bya rgod phung po’i ri la | dge slong gi dge ’dun chen po dang | byang chub sems dpa’i dge ’dun chen po dang thabs cig (145a1) tu bzhugs te | de’i tshe bcom ldan ’das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba’i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge ’dzin la mos par zhugs so ||
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Conze (1973) 140 -: Thus have I heard at one time. The Lord dwelled at Rājagṛha, on the Vulture Peak, together with a large gathering of both monks and Bodhisattvas. At that time the Lord, after he had taught the discourse on dharma called «deep splendour», had entered into concentration.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: (7)如是我聞。一時佛在王舍大城靈鷲山中。與(8)大比丘衆滿百千人。菩薩摩訶薩七萬七千(9)人倶。其名曰觀世音菩薩。文殊師利菩薩。彌(10)勒菩薩等。以爲上首。皆得三昧總持。

verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: Avalokiteśwara (The Devatā of the Sūtra). When the Prajnā Pāramitā has been fully practised, then clearly behold that the five skandhas are all empty, vain, and unreal. So it is we escape the possibility of sorrow or obstruction.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: (10)觀世音菩薩。行深般若波羅蜜時。照見五陰(11)空。度一切苦厄。

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §6】Chi: Dharmacandra 法月 (738CE) T.252 849a5 - 849b19：世尊。我欲於此會中。説(15)諸菩薩普遍智藏般若波羅蜜多心。唯願世(16)尊聽我所説。爲諸菩薩宣祕法要。爾時世尊(17)以妙梵音。告觀自在菩薩摩訶薩言。 | 藏本 (Tib: Vimalamitra and Rin chen sde, Kg 21, shes phyin sna tshogs, ka 144b6 - 146a2-3)：rigs kyi bu’am | rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyod pa spyad par ’dod pa des ji ltar bslab par bya | de skad ces smras pa dang | byang chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang (4) phyug gis tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti’i bu la ’di skad ces smras so ||

verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: So there will be no such thing as ignorance (avdiyā), nor yet freedom from ignorance, and therefore these can be none of its consequences (viz., the twelve nidānas. Colebrooke p.255); and therefore no such thing as decay or death (jarā or maraṅa), nor yet freedom from decay and death. So neither can there be a method (or way) for destroying the concourse of sorrows. No such thing as wisdom, and no such thing as attaining (happiness or rest), as there will not be ought that can be attained.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: (19)無無明亦無無明盡。乃至無老死無老死盡。(20)無苦集滅道。無智亦無得。以無所得故。

Tārānamaskāraikaviṃśatistotra
namas tārāyai
namastāre ture vīre kṣaṇadyutinibhekṣaṇe | trailokyanāthavaktrābja- vikasatkamalodbhave
namaḥ śataśaraccandra- saṃpūrṇapaṭalānane | tārāsahasranikara- prahasatkiraṇojjvale
namaḥ kanakanīlābja- pāṇipadmavibhūṣite | dānavīryatapaḥśānti- titikṣādhyānagocare
namas tathāgatoṣṇīṣa- vijayānantacāriṇi | 'śeṣapāramitāprāpta- jinaputraniṣevite
namas tutrārehuṃkāra- pūritāśādigantare | saptalokakramākrānti niśeṣākarṣaṇakṣame
namaḥ śakrānalabrahma- marudviśveśvarārcite | bhūtavetālagandharva- gaṇayakṣapuraskṛte
namas traḍ iti phaṭkāra- parayantrapramardini | pratyālīḍhapadanyāse śikhijvālākulojjvale
namas ture mahāghore mālavīravināśini | bhṛkuṭīkṛtavaktrābja- sarvaśatruniṣūdini
namas triratnamudrāṅka- hṛdyāṅgulivibhūṣite | bhūṣitāśeṣadikcakra- nikarasvakarākule
namaḥ pramuditāśeṣa- muktākṣīraprasāriṇi | hasatprahasattutāre māralokavaśaṃkari
namaḥ samantabhūpāla- paṭalākarṣaṇakṣame | caladbhṛkuṭihūṃkāra- sarvāpadavimocini
namaḥ śikhaṇḍakhaṇḍendu- mukuṭābharaṇojjvale | amitābhajaṭābhāra- bhāsvārakiraṇadhruve
namaḥ kalpāntahutabhug- jvālāmālāntarasthite | ālīḍhamuditābaddha- ripucakravināśini
namaḥ karatalāghāta- caraṇāhatabhūtale | bhṛkuṭīkṛtahuṃkāra- saptapātālabhedini
namaḥ śive śubhe śānte śāntanirvāṇagocare | svāhāpraṇavasaṃyukte mahāpātakanāśini
namaḥ pramuditābaddha- ripugātraprabhedini | daśākṣarapadanyāsa- vidyāhuṃkāradīpite
namas ture pādaghāte huṃkārabījite | merumaṇḍārakailāsa- bhuvanatrayacāliṇi
namaḥ surasarākāra- hariṇāṅkakarasthite | tāradviruktaphaṭkāra aśeṣaviṣanāśini
namaḥ suragaṇayakṣa- kiṃnarasevite | ābaddhamuditābhoga- kaliduḥsvapnanāśini
namaś candrārkasampūrṇa- nayanadyutibhāsvare | haradviruktatuttāre- viṣamajvaranāśini
namaḥ tritatāvinyāsa- śivaśaktisamanvite | grahavetālayakṣoṣma- nāśini pravare ture
mantramūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namaskāraikaviṃśakaṃ | yaḥ paṭhet prasannadhīmān devyāṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ
sāyaṃ vā prātarutthāya smaret sarvābhayapradam | sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvadurgatināśanam
abhiṣikto bhavet tūrṇaṃ saptabhir jinakoṭibhiḥ | asmin mahattvam āpadya so 'nte bauddhapadaṃ vrajet
viṣaṃ tasya mahāghoraṃ sthāvaraṃ vātha jaṅgamam | smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yāti khāditaṃ pītam eva vā
grahajvaraviṣārtīnāṃ paramātiviṣanāśānām | anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ dvitrisaptābhivārttinām
putrakāmo labhet putraṃ ghanakāmo labhed dhanam | sarvakāmānavāpnoti na vighnaiḥ pratihanyate
iti śrīsamyaksaṃbuddhavairocanabhāṣitaṃ bhagavatyāryatārādevyā namaskāraikaviṃśatināmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ buddhabhāṣitaṃ parisamāptam

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §1】Chi: T.1108A：聖救度佛母二十一種禮讚經 翰林學士承旨中奉大夫安藏奉 詔譯 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：rgya gar skad du | na maḥtā rā e ka biṃ śa ti sto tra gu ṇa hi ta sā ka | bod skad du | sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal nyi śu rtsa gcig gis bstod pa phan yon daṅ bcas pa |

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §2】Chi: T.1108A：唵敬禮多哩速疾勇，咄多哩者除怖畏，咄哩能授諸勝義，具莎訶字我讚禮！ | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo ||
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 2.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵敬禮多哩速疾勇，咄多哩者除怖畏，咄哩能授諸勝義，具莎訶字我讚禮！

verses.iast: namaḥ śive śubhe śānte śāntanirvāṇagocare | svāhāpraṇavasaṃyukte mahāpātakanāśini

verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 17.

verses.iast: namas ture pādaghāte huṃkārabījite | merumaṇḍārakailāsa- bhuvanatrayacāliṇi
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §19】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮都哩巴帝母 足躡相勢吽字種 彌嚕曼陀結辣薩 於此三處能搖動 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal tu re'i źabs ni brdabs pas | | hūṃ gi rnam pa'i sa bon ñid ma | | ri rab man dā ra daṅ 'bigs byed | | 'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba ñid ma | |(17)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §20】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮薩囉天海母 手中執住神獸像 誦二怛囉作發聲 能滅諸毒盡無餘 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i | | ri dags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma | | tā ra gñis brjod phaṭ kyi yi ges | | dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma | |(18)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §21】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮諸天集會母 天緊那羅所依愛 威德歡悅若堅鎧 滅除鬪諍及惡夢 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po | | lha daṅ mi'am ci yis bsten ma | | kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis | | rtsod daṅ rmi lam ṅan pa sel ma | |(19)
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 21.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮諸天集會母 天緊那羅所依愛 威德歡悅若堅鎧 滅除鬪諍及惡夢

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §22】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮日月廣圓母 目覩猶勝普光照 誦二喝囉咄怛哩 善除惡毒瘟熱病 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal ñi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i | | spyan gñis po la 'od rab gsal ma | | ha ra gñis brjod tu ttā ra yis | | śin tu drag po'i rims ni sel ma | |(20)
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 22.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮日月廣圓母 目覩猶勝普光照 誦二喝囉咄怛哩 善除惡毒瘟熱病

verses.iast: namaḥ tritatāvinyāsa- śivaśaktisamanvite | grahavetālayakṣoṣma- nāśini pravare ture
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §23】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮具三真實母 善靜威力皆具足 藥叉執魅尾怛辣 都哩最極除災禍 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal de ñid gsum rnams bkod pa'i | | źi ba'i mthu daṅ yaṅ dag ldan ma | | gdon daṅ ro laṅs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams | | 'joms pa tu re rab mchog ñid ma | |(21)
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 23.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮具三真實母 善靜威力皆具足 藥叉執魅尾怛辣 都哩最極除災禍
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A

verses.iast: mantramūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namaskāraikaviṃśakaṃ | yaḥ paṭhet prasannadhīmān devyāṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §24】Chi: T.1108A：若有智者勤精進 至心誦此二十一 救度尊處誠信禮 是故讚嘆根本呪 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：rtsa ba'i sṅags kyis bstod pa 'di daṅ | | phyag 'tshal ba ni ñi śu rtsa gcig | | lha mo la gus yaṅ dag ldan pa'i | | blo ldan gaṅ gis rab tu brjod pas | |(22)
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 24.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 若有智者勤精進 至心誦此二十一 救度尊處誠信禮 是故讚嘆根本呪
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A

verses.iast: sāyaṃ vā prātarutthāya smaret sarvābhayapradam | sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvadurgatināśanam
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §25】Chi: T.1108A：每晨旦起夕時禮 憶念施諸勝無畏 一切罪業盡消除 悉能超越諸惡趣 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：srod daṅ tho raṅs laṅs par byas nas | | dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster | | sdig pa thams cad rab tu źi ba | | ṅan 'gro thams cad 'joms pa ñid do | (23)
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 25.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 每晨旦起夕時禮 憶念施諸勝無畏 一切罪業盡消除 悉能超越諸惡趣
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A

verses.iast: abhiṣikto bhavet tūrṇaṃ saptabhir jinakoṭibhiḥ | asmin mahattvam āpadya so 'nte bauddhapadaṃ vrajet
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §26】Chi: T.1108A：此等速能得聰慧 七俱胝佛所灌頂 現世富貴壽延安 當來趣向諸佛位 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：rgyal ba bye ba phrag bdun rnams kyis | | myur du dbaṅ ni bskur bar 'gyur la | | 'di las che ba ñid ni 'thob ciṅ | | saṅs rgyas go 'phaṅ mthar thug der 'gro | |(24)
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 26.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 此等速能得聰慧 七俱胝佛所灌頂 現世富貴壽延安 當來趣向諸佛位
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A

verses.iast: viṣaṃ tasya mahāghoraṃ sthāvaraṃ vātha jaṅgamam | smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yāti khāditaṃ pītam eva vā
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §27】Chi: T.1108A：有時誤服諸毒物 或自然生或合成 憶念聖尊真實力 諸惡毒藥盡消滅 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：de yi dug ni drag po chen po | | brtan gnas pa'am gźan yaṅ 'gro ba | | zos pa daṅ ni 'thuṅs pa ñid kyaṅ | | dran pas rab tu sel ba ñid thob | |(25)
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 27.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 有時誤服諸毒物 或自然生或合成 憶念聖尊真實力 諸惡毒藥盡消滅
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A

verses.iast: grahajvaraviṣārtīnāṃ paramātiviṣanāśānām | anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ dvitrisaptābhivārttinām
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §28】Chi: T.1108A：或見他人遭鬼魅 或發熱病受諸苦 若轉此讚二三七 彼諸苦惱悉蠲除 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：gdon daṅ rims daṅ dug gis gzir ba'i | | sdug bsṅal tshogs ni rnam par spoṅ ste | | sems can gźan pa rnams la yaṅ ṅo | | gñis gsum bdun du mṅon par brjod na | |(26)
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 28.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 或見他人遭鬼魅 或發熱病受諸苦 若轉此讚二三七 彼諸苦惱悉蠲除
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A

verses.iast: putrakāmo labhet putraṃ ghanakāmo labhed dhanam | sarvakāmānavāpnoti na vighnaiḥ pratihanyate
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §29】Chi: T.1108A：欲乞男女得男女 求財寶位獲富饒 善能圓滿隨意願 一切障礙不能侵 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur źiṅ | | nor 'dod pas ni nor rnams ñid thob | | 'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur te | | bgegs rnams med ciṅ so sor 'joms 'gyur | |
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 29.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 欲乞男女得男女 求財寶位獲富饒 善能圓滿隨意願 一切障礙不能侵
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A

verses.iast: iti śrīsamyaksaṃbuddhavairocanabhāṣitaṃ bhagavatyāryatārādevyā namaskāraikaviṃśatināmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ buddhabhāṣitaṃ parisamāptam
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §30】Chi: T.1108A：根本十字真言： 唵 多(引) 哩 咄(入) 多 哩 都 哩 莎(引) 訶(引)。救度八難真言： 唵 多(引) 哩 咄 多 哩 都 哩 薩 哩嚩(二合) 琶 耶 那(引) 舍 儞 薩 哩嚩(二合) 覩(入) 枯(入) 多(引) 哩 禰 莎(引) 訶(引) | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa'i saṅs rgyas kyis bstod pa gsuṅs pa rdzogs so || ||
verses.meaningEn: Bibliotheca Polyglotta (vid=1134) parallel alignment row 30.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 根本十字真言： 唵 多(引) 哩 咄(入) 多 哩 都 哩 莎(引) 訶(引)。救度八難真言： 唵 多(引) 哩 咄 多 哩 都 哩 薩 哩嚩(二合) 琶 耶 那(引) 舍 儞 薩 哩嚩(二合) 覩(入) 枯(入) 多(引) 哩 禰 莎(引) 訶(引)

Nirvikalpapraveśadhāraṇī
1v1)(... evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin sa)maye bhagavān rājagṛhe virahati sma
tatra khalu bhagavā(3)(n anekaśatasahasrayā parṣadā parivṛtaḥ puraskṛto) dharmaṃ deśayati sma | yad uta dharmāṇāṃ nirvikalpatām ārabhya
atha tasyām eva parṣady avikalpaprabhāso nāma bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ
bhagavāṃs teṣām etad avocat
tasya tāni kramaśo vikalpanimittāni parivarjayataḥ
tasya tāni pari(2)(varjayataḥ tadanyāni tattvanirūpaṇavikalpani)mittāni samudācaranty āmukhībhavanty ābhāsagamanayogena
tasya tāny api parivarjayato ’parāṇi prāptinirūpaṇavikalpanimittāni samudācaranty āmukhībhavanty ābhāsagamanayogena
evaṃ sa bodhisattvo mahāsattva etāni sarvākāravikalpanimittāny amanasikārataḥ parivarjayan suprayukto bhavaty avikalpena
kena kāraṇena kulaputrā avikalpadhātur avikalpa ity ucyate
katarat tad avikalpaṃ
tad yathā kulaputrā ekaghanasāramayasya pāṣāṇaparvatasyādhastān mahānānāratnaparipūrṇanidhiḥ syād ( | ) bhāsurāṇāṃ vicitrāṇāṃ mahācintāmaṇiratnānāṃ | yad uta rūpyaratnasya vā | suvarṇaratnasya vā | (3)(aśmagarbhanānāratnasya vā
tathā hi kulaputrā iyam upamā kṛ)tā yāvad evāsyārthasya vijñaptaye
kathaṃ punaḥ kulaputrā bodhisattvo mahāsattva etāni yathānirdiṣṭāni vikalpanimittāni vyupaparī(3r1)(kṣamāṇo ’vikalpadhātuṃ praviśati
iha kulaputrāḥ bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvākārajñatānirūpaṇavikalpanimitta āmukhībhūta evaṃ vyupaparīkṣate
asya kulaputrā dharmaparyāyasya udgrahaṇalekhanavācanād bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ nanv eva gaṅgānadīvālukopamātmabhāvaparityāgasya nanv eva gaṃgānadīvālukopamalokādhātuparipūrṇaratnadānasya nanv eva gaṃgānadīvālukopamalpkadhātuparipūrṇatathāgatabiṃbakārāpaṇapuṇyaskandhasyeti
atha khalu bhagavāṃs tasyāṃ velāyāṃ ime gāthe abhāṣata
idam avocad bahgavān āttamanā avikalpaprabhāsaś ca bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §1】T. 449 404c13-401a26 - 401b20-24：(401a04)藥師如來本願功德經序 (401a05)藥師如來本願經者，致福消災之要法也；曼殊以慈悲之力請說尊號，如來以利物之心盛陳功業；十二大願彰因行之弘遠，七寶莊嚴顯果德之純淨；憶念稱名則眾苦咸脫，祈請供養則諸願皆滿；至於病士求救應死更生，王者攘災轉禍為福；信是消百怪之神符，除九橫之妙術矣。(401a11)昔宋孝武之世，鹿野寺沙門慧簡已曾譯出在世流行，但以梵宋不融、文辭雜糅，致令轉讀之輩多生疑惑。矩早學梵書恒披葉典，思遇此經驗其紕謬；開皇十七年初獲一本，猶恐脫誤未敢即翻，至大業十一年復得二本，更相讎比方為揩定，遂與三藏法師達磨笈多，并大隋翻經沙門法行明則、長順海馭等，於東都洛水南上林園翻經舘重譯此本。深鑑前非方懲後失，故一言出口必三覆乃書，傳度幽旨差無大過；其年十二月八日翻勘方了，仍為一卷。(401a21)所願此經深義人人共解，彼佛名號處處遍聞，十二夜叉念佛恩而護國，七千眷屬承經力以利民，帝祚遐永，群生安樂，式貽來世序云爾。 佛說藥師如來本願經 (401a26)新翻藥師經，大業十二年十二月八日，沙門慧矩等六人，於東都洛水南上林園譯出。此本最定，諸讀誦者願莫更疑，得罪不輕。 | 藏本 (Kj D 274a2 - 274b2-4)：(2)saṅs rgyas daṅ byaṅ chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo ||

233,1)21: dhāraṇīparivartaḥ
atha khalu bhaiṣajyarājo bodhisattvo mahāsattva utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantam etad avocat kiyad bhagavan sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā puṇyaṃ prasavet, ya imaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ dhārayet, kāyagataṃ vā pustakagataṃ vā kṛtvā?
atha khalu bhaiṣajyarājo bodhisattvo mahāsattvas tasyāṃ velāyāṃ bhagavantam etad avocat
anye manye mane mamane citte carite same samitā viśānte mukte muktatame same aviṣame samasame jaye kṣaye akṣaye akṣiṇe śānte samite dhāraṇi ālokabhāṣe pratyavekṣaṇi nidhiru abhyantaraniviṣṭe abhyantarapāriśuddhimutkule araḍe paraḍe sukāṅkṣi asamasame buddhavilokite dharmaparīkṣite saṃghanirghoṣaṇi nirghoṇi bhayābhayaviśodhani mantre mantrākṣayate rute rutakauśalye akṣaye akṣayavanatāye vakkule valoḍra amanyanatāye svāhā
imāni bhagavan mantradhāraṇīpadāni dvāṣaṣṭibhir gaṅgānadīvālikāsamair buddhair bhagavadbhir bhāṣitāni
atha khalu bhagavān bhaiṣajyarājāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya sādhukāramadāt sādhu sādhu bhaiṣajyarāja, sattvānām arthaḥ kṛtaḥ
atha khalu pradānaśūro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavantam etad avocat
234,1) atha khalu pradānaśūro bodhisattvo mahāsattvas tasyāṃ velāyām imāni dhāraṇīmantrapadāni bhāṣate sma
jvale mahājvale ukke tukke mukke aḍe aḍāvati nṛtye nṛtyāvati iṭṭini viṭṭini ciṭṭini nṛtyani nṛtyāvati svāhā
imāni bhagavan dhāraṇīpadāni gaṅgānadīvālikāsamais tathāgatair arhadbhiḥ samyaksaṃbuddhair bhāṣitāni, anumoditāni ca
atha khalu vaiśravaṇo mahārājo bhagavantam etad avocat
aṭṭe taṭṭe naṭṭe vanaṭṭe anaḍe nāḍi kunaḍi svāhā
ebhir bhagavan dhāraṇīpadaisteṣāṃ dharmabhāṇakānāṃ pudgalānāṃ rakṣāṃ karomi, yojanaśatāccāhaṃ teṣāṃ kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṛṇāṃ ca evaṃrūpāṇāṃ sūtrāntadhārakāṇāṃ rakṣā kṛtā bhaviṣyati, svastyayanaṃ kṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati
atha khalu virūḍhako mahārājo tasyām eva parṣadi saṃnipatito ’bhūt saṃniṣaṇṇaś ca kumbhāṇḍakoṭīnayutaśatasahasraiḥ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛtaḥ
agaṇe gaṇe gauri gandhāri caṇḍāli mātaṅgi pukkasi saṃkule vrūsali sisi svāhā
imāni tāni bhagavan dhāraṇīmantrapadāni, yāni dvācatvāriṃśadbhir buddhakoṭībhir bhāṣitāni
atha khalu lambā ca nāma rākṣasī vilambā ca nāma rākṣasī kūṭadantī ca nāma rākṣasī puṣpadantī ca nāma rākṣasī makuṭadantī ca nāma rākṣasī keśinī ca nāma rākṣasī acalā ca nāma rākṣasī mālādhārī ca nāma rākṣasī kuntī ca nāma rākṣasī sarvasattvojohārī ca nāma rākṣasī hārītī ca nāma rākṣasī saputraparivārā etāḥ sarvā rākṣasyo yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntāḥ
atha khalu tāḥ sarvā rākṣasya ekasvareṇa samaṃ saṃgītyā bhagavata imāni dhāraṇīmantrapadāni prayacchanti sma
imaṃ śīrṣaṃ samāruhya mā kaścid drohī bhavatu dharmabhāṇakānāṃ yakṣo vā rākṣaso vā preto vā piśāco vā pūtano vā kṛtyo va vetālo vā kumbhāṇḍo vā stabdho vā omārako vā ostārako vā apasmārako vā yakṣakṛtyo vā amanuṣyakṛtyo vā manuṣyakṛtyo vā ekāhiko vā dvaitīyako vā traitīyako vā caturthako vā nityajvaro vā viṣamajvaro vā
atha khalu tā rākṣasya evasvareṇa samaṃ saṃgītyā bhagavantam ābhir gāthābhir adhyabhāṣanta
saptadhāsya sphuṭenmūrdhā arjakasyeva mañjarī | ya imaṃ mantra śrutvā vai atikrameddharmabhāṇakam
yā gatirmātṛghātīnāṃ pitṛghātīna yā gatiḥ | tāṃ gatiṃ pratigacchedyo dharmabhāṇakamatikramet
yā gatistilapīḍānāṃ tilakūṭānāṃ ca yā gatiḥ | tāṃ gatiṃ pratigacchedyo dharmabhāṇakamatikramet
yā gatistulakūṭānāṃ kāṃsyakūṭāna yā gatiḥ | tāṃ gatiṃ pratigacchedyo dharmabhāṇakamatikramet
evamuktvā tāḥ kuntipramukhā rākṣasyo bhagavantam etadūcuḥ - vayam api bhagavaṃsteṣām evaṃrūpāṇāṃ dharmabhāṇakānāṃ rakṣāṃ kariṣyāmaḥ, svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ kariṣyāma iti
asmin khalu punar dhāraṇīparivarte nirdiśyamāne aṣṭāṣaṣṭīnāṃ prāṇisahasrāṇām anutpattikadharmakṣāntipratilābho ’bhūt
iti śrīsaddharmapuṇḍarīke dharmaparyāye dhāraṇīparivarto nāmaikaviṃśatimaḥ

verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：56b1(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya a pa ri mi ta A yur+dz+nya na nA ma ma hA yA na sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：yi ger 'drir 'jug na de dag gi yon tan dang legs par 'gyur ba ni 'di dag go།  ། ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  a ba ri mi ta A yur+dz+nyA na su bi nish+tsi ta te dzo rA dzA ya།  ta thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te saM myak+saM bud+d+hA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ pu N+ye pu N+ye མ་ཧཱ pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ya dz+nyA na saM b+ha ro pa tsi te།  ཨོཾ sarba saM skA ra pa ri shud+d+ha d+har+m+ma te ga ga na sa mut+ga te swa b+hA ba bi shud+d+he མ་ཧཱ na ya pa ri bA re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'jam dpal དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag gang la la zhig yi ger 'dri 'am yi ger 'drir 'jug gam།  glegs bam la bris te khyim na 'chang ngam klog par gyur pa de'i tshe zad pa las tshe lo brgya thub par 'gyur te།  'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ tshe dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa sogs par skye bar 'gyur ro།  ། ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  a ba ri（EWTS: yi ger 'drir 'jug na de dag gi yon tan dang legs par 'gyur ba ni 'di dag go/ /o~M na mo b+ha ga ba te/ a ba ri mi ta A yur+dz+nyA na su bi nish+tsi ta te dzo rA dzA ya/ ta thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te saM myak+saM bud+d+hA ya/ tad+ya thA/ o~M pu N+ye pu N+ye ma hA pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ya dz+nyA na saM b+ha ro pa tsi te/ o~M sarba saM skA ra pa ri shud+d+ha d+har+m+ma te ga ga na sa mut+ga te swa b+hA ba bi shud+d+he ma hA na ya pa ri bA re swA hA/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag gang la la zhig yi ger 'dri 'am yi ger 'drir 'jug gam/ glegs bam la bris te khyim na 'chang ngam klog par gyur pa de'i tshe zad pa las tshe lo brgya thub par 'gyur te/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa sogs par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /o~M na mo b+ha ga ba te/ a ba ri）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：77b7(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya tsan+dan ang+ga nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ tsan+dan gyi yan lag ces bya ba'i གཟུངས。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：79b5(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya a gra pra dI pa d+hA ra NI bi d+yA rA dzA；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ རིག་སྔགས kyi rgyal po sgron ma mchog gi གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：le dz+wa le།  dz+wa le ga te།  huk+ku།  muk+ku།  saM ma te།  མ་ཧཱ saM ma te།  མ་ཧཱ dz+wa le།  dz+wa ba la me།  sa he sa he།  མ་ཧཱ dz+wa le།  uk+ke muk+ke།  sha me།  saM ma te།  མ་ཧཱ saM ma te།  མ་ཧཱ sha me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyis tshe dang ldan ba kun dga' bo la phe།  hi li mi li།  ti le སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' po la bka' stsal pa།  kun dga' bo khyod kyis གཟུངས kyi གསང་སྔགས 'di 'di dag zung shig ། long shig ། chos shig ། lhogs shig ། kun dza hi la ba te།  tsaN+DIl ba te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa།  kun dga' bo khyod གཟུངས kyi གསང་སྔགས gzhi 'di dag zung shig ། long shig ། chongs shig ། lhogs shig ། kun chub par（EWTS: le dz+wa le/ dz+wa le ga te/ huk+ku/ muk+ku/ saM ma te/ ma hA saM ma te/ ma hA dz+wa le/ dz+wa ba la me/ sa he sa he/ ma hA dz+wa le/ uk+ke muk+ke/ sha me/ saM ma te/ ma hA saM ma te/ ma hA sha me swA hA/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan ba kun dga' bo la phe/ hi li mi li/ ti le swA hA/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' po la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis gzungs kyi gsang sngags 'di 'di dag zung shig /long shig /chos shig /lhogs shig /kun dza hi la ba te/ tsaN+DIl ba te swA hA/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag zung shig /long shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：87b4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：b+ha ga bA na a mi tA b+ha d+hA ra NI man+t+ra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས snang ba mtha' 87b5(གཟུངས): yas kyi གཟུངས sngags。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：Ta ni།  sarba pA pa ni།  bud+d+ha a d+hiSh+ThA ni na སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  འཕགས་པ rgyal ba'i bla ma'i གཟུངས rdzogs so།  @#།  ། rgya gar skad du།  b+ha ga bA na a mi tA b+ha དྷཱ་ར་ཎཱི man+t+ra།  bod skad du།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས snang ba mtha' mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re sarba kle shak+Sha yaM ka ri སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  གཟུངས 'di'i yon tan ni bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yang 'di lan gsum bzlas brjod byas na sgrib pa de rnams zad par 'gyur ro།  ། lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na rtsa ba bzhi'i ltung du hi ke སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  lus la nad byung ba'am།  nad khong skams su gyur kyang rung ste།  lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bsngags te།  bsil yab kyis de la g.yabs na nad med par 'gyur ro།  ། གཟུངས sngags de gsungs ma thag tu 'khor thams cad yi rangs te།（EWTS: Ta ni/ sarba pA pa ni/ bud+d+ha a d+hiSh+ThA ni na swA hA/ 'phags pa rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs rdzogs so// @#/ /rgya gar skad du/ b+ha ga bA na a mi tA b+ha d+hA ra NI man+t+ra/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re sarba kle shak+Sha yaM ka ri swA hA/ gzungs 'di'i yon tan ni bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yang 'di lan gsum bzlas brjod byas na sgrib pa de rnams zad par 'gyur ro/ /lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na rtsa ba bzhi'i ltung du hi ke swA hA/ lus la nad byung ba'am/ nad khong skams su gyur kyang rung ste/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bsngags te/ bsil yab kyis de la g.yabs na nad med par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs sngags de gsungs ma thag tu 'khor thams cad yi rangs te/）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：na la se།  a na la saM b+ha be།  a na la sa ga tiM ga te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  he ma he ma།  ha ma ha ma སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  a mi tot+b+ha be།  a mi ta saM b+ha be།  a mi ta bi krAn+te།  a mi ta bi krAn+ti ka re།  a mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  ga ga na a ka ra།  ga ga na saM b+ha be།  ga ga na kIrti ka re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ kun nas spos mchog la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  sa ma sa me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug bsgrags gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  a sa ma sa me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de bzhin（EWTS: na la se/ a na la saM b+ha be/ a na la sa ga tiM ga te swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ he ma he ma/ ha ma ha ma swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ a mi tot+b+ha be/ a mi ta saM b+ha be/ a mi ta bi krAn+te/ a mi ta bi krAn+ti ka re/ a mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ ga ga na a ka ra/ ga ga na saM b+ha be/ ga ga na kIrti ka re swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas spos mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ sa ma sa me swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug bsgrags gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ a sa ma sa me swA hA/ de bzhin）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.tangNoteZh: 藏文音译原貌：na la se།  a na la saM b+ha be།  a na la sa ga tiM ga te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  he ma he ma།  ha ma ha ma སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  a mi tot+b+ha be།  a mi ta saM b+ha be།  a mi ta bi krAn+te།  a mi ta bi krAn+ti ka re།  a mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  ga ga na a ka ra།  ga ga na saM b+ha be།  ga ga na kIrti ka re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ kun nas spos mchog la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  sa ma sa me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug bsgrags gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  a sa ma sa me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de bzhin

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：122a2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya aSh+Ta maN+Dal ka nA ma ma hA yA na sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes 122a3(གཟུངས): bya ba ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：legs so།  ། rigs kyi bu de'i phyir སྙིང་པོ gang brjod pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga 'byang zhing །  dngos grub thams cad kyang thob par 'gyur ba བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ brgyad kyi སྙིང་པོ nyon cig ། ཨོཾ མ་ཧཱ ཧཱུྃ མ་ཧཱ bI ra སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  སྙིང་པོ 'dis ni dbus kyi བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས mchod do།  ། ཨོཾ hrI ཧཱུྃ པདྨ pri ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ mai hA rA Na སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  byams pa'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ A kA sha gar+b+hA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  nam mkha'i སྙིང་པོ'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ swA hri rA dza ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  kun du bzang po'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ ku ru b+ha na ra ha སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  lag na rdo rje'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ shrI aM ra~M ga སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ ni swA ra~M b+ha སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ k+Shi ti ha（EWTS: legs so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir snying po gang brjod pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga 'byang zhing / dngos grub thams cad kyang thob par 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi snying po nyon cig /o~M ma hA hU~M ma hA bI ra swA hA/ snying po 'dis ni dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das mchod do/ /o~M hrI hU~M pad+ma pri ya swA hA/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'o/ /o~M mai hA rA Na swA hA/ byams pa'i snying po'o/ /o~M A kA sha gar+b+hA ya swA hA/ nam mkha'i snying po'i snying po'o/ /o~M swA hri rA dza ya swA hA/ kun du bzang po'i snying po'o/ /o~M ku ru b+ha na ra ha swA hA/ lag na rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /o~M shrI aM ra~M ga swA hA/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i snying po'o/ /o~M ni swA ra~M b+ha swA hA/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i snying po'o/ /o~M k+Shi ti ha）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：123a2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya sarba ta thA ga ta a d+hiSh+ThA na hr-i da ya gu h+ya d+hA tu ka raN+Da nA ma d+hA ra NI ma hA yA na sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi སྙིང་པོ gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i གཟུངས ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：dag ste།  chos kyi sku dang །  longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang །  de bzhin du sprul pa'i sku ste།  dus gsum pa thams cad kyi ring bsrel gyi za ma tog gi phyag rgya'i གཟུངས kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yin no།  ། na ma s+t+rai ya d+h+wi kAnAM།  sarba ta thA ga tA nAM།  ཨོཾ b+hu bi b+ha bA na ba re ba tsa Tau།  tsu lu tsu lu།  d+ha re d+ha re།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  d+hA tu d+ha re།  པདྨ gar+b+he།  dza ya ba re།  a tsa le།  sma ra ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  d+har+m+ma tsakra།  pra bar+t+ta na།  བཛྲ bo d+hi maN+Da a laM kA ra།  a laM kr-i te།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  a d+hiSh+Thi te།  bo d+ha ya bo d+ha ya།  bo bud+d+ha།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ a d+hiSh+Thi te།  d+hA tu gar+b+he སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sa ma ya a d+hiSh+Thi te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ hr-i da ya།  d+hA tu mu dre སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  su pra tiSh+Thi ta།  stu be ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ a d+hiSh+Thi te།  ཧཱུྃ ཧཱུྃ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ uSh+NI Sha d+hA tu mu drA Ni།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ d+harma d+hA tu bi b+hu Shi ta a d+hiSh+Thi te（EWTS: dag ste/ chos kyi sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / de bzhin du sprul pa'i sku ste/ dus gsum pa thams cad kyi ring bsrel gyi za ma tog gi phyag rgya'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yin no/ /na ma s+t+rai ya d+h+wi kAnAM/ sarba ta thA ga tA nAM/ o~M b+hu bi b+ha bA na ba re ba tsa Tau/ tsu lu tsu lu/ d+ha re d+ha re/ sarba ta thA ga ta/ d+hA tu d+ha re/ pad+ma gar+b+he/ dza ya ba re/ a tsa le/ sma ra ta thA ga ta/ d+har+m+ma tsakra/ pra bar+t+ta na/ badzra bo d+hi maN+Da a laM kA ra/ a laM kr-i te/ sarba ta thA ga ta/ a d+hiSh+Thi te/ bo d+ha ya bo d+ha ya/ bo bud+d+ha/ sarba ta thA ga ta a d+hiSh+Thi te/ d+hA tu gar+b+he swA hA/ sa ma ya a d+hiSh+Thi te swA hA/ sarba ta thA ga ta hr-i da ya/ d+hA tu mu dre swA hA/ su pra tiSh+Thi ta/ stu be ta thA ga ta a d+hiSh+Thi te/ hU~M hU~M swA hA/ o~M sarba ta thA ga ta uSh+NI Sha d+hA tu mu drA Ni/ sarba ta thA ga ta d+harma d+hA tu bi b+hu Shi ta a d+hiSh+Thi te）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.tangNoteZh: 藏文音译原貌：dag ste།  chos kyi sku dang །  longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang །  de bzhin du sprul pa'i sku ste།  dus gsum pa thams cad kyi ring bsrel gyi za ma tog gi phyag rgya'i གཟུངས kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yin no།  ། na ma s+t+rai ya d+h+wi kAnAM།  sarba ta thA ga tA nAM།  ཨོཾ b+hu bi b+ha bA na ba re ba tsa Tau།  tsu lu tsu lu།  d+ha re d+ha re།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  d+hA tu d+ha re།  པདྨ gar+b+he།  dza ya ba re།  a tsa le།  sma ra ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  d+har+m+ma tsakra།  pra bar+t+ta na།  བཛྲ bo d+hi maN+Da a laM kA ra།  a laM kr-i te།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  a d+hiSh+Thi te།  bo d+ha ya bo d+ha ya།  bo bud+d+ha།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ a d+hiSh+Thi te།  d+hA tu gar+b+he སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sa ma ya a d+hiSh+Thi te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ hr-i da ya།  d+hA tu mu dre སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  su pra tiSh+Thi ta།  stu be ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ a d+hiSh+Thi te།  ཧཱུྃ ཧཱུྃ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ uSh+NI Sha d+hA tu mu drA Ni།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ d+harma d+hA tu bi b+hu Shi ta a d+hiSh+Thi te

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  shAkya mu na ye།  ta thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te།  samyak+saM bud d+hA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ a dzi te།  a dzi te།  a pa rA dzi te།  a dzi tan dza ya།  ha ra ha ra།  mai tri a ba lo ki te།  ka ra ka ra།  མ་ཧཱ sa ma ya sid+d+he།  b+ha ra b+ha ra།  མ་ཧཱ bo d+hi maN+Da bI dze།  sma ra sma ra།  A sma kaM sa ma ya།  bo d+hi bo d+hi།  མ་ཧཱ bo d+hi སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  rtsa ba'i གསང་སྔགས so།  ། ཨོཾ mo hi mo hi།  མ་ཧཱ mo hi སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  སྙིང་པོ'o།  ཨོཾ mu ni mu ni sma ra སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  nye ba'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། གཟུངས 'di nyan pa tsam dang །  klog pa dang །  kha ton byed pa dang །  tshul bzhin yid la pa byams pas dam bcas pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས rdzogs so།  །  ། rgya gar gyi mkhan po བཛྲ pA Ni dang །  bod kyi lots+tsha ba།  dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa།  །（EWTS: oM na mo b+ha ga ba te/ shAkya mu na ye/ ta thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saM bud d+hA ya/ tad+ya thA/ oM a dzi te/ a dzi te/ a pa rA dzi te/ a dzi tan dza ya/ ha ra ha ra/ mai tri a ba lo ki te/ ka ra ka ra/ ma hA sa ma ya sid+d+he/ b+ha ra b+ha ra/ ma hA bo d+hi maN+Da bI dze/ sma ra sma ra/ A sma kaM sa ma ya/ bo d+hi bo d+hi/ ma hA bo d+hi swA hA/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags so/ /o~M mo hi mo hi/ ma hA mo hi swA hA/ snying po'o/ o~M mu ni mu ni sma ra swA hA/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /gzungs 'di nyan pa tsam dang / klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la pa byams pas dam bcas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/ / //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pA Ni dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba/ dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：166a5(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya A pa ra Na bi skaM b+hi nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ sgrib pa rnam par sel ba ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：sdig pa thams cad 'byang zhing 'chi ba'i dus su bde ba nyid du dus byed par 'gyur ro།  ། ཨོཾ shwe ta wa ra bi dza li ne སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'i སྙིང་པོ 'di nyin lan bdun mtshan lan bdun brjod na las brgyud mar bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad 'byang zhing 'chi ba'i dus su gnad gcod pa'i sdug bsngal drag po mi 'byung ngo །  ། bde ba nyid du dus byed par 'gyur ro།  ། ཨོཾ sarba A ba ra Na bi skaM b+hi ne སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa de dag rnams la bshos gtsang la sogs pa'i mchod pas（EWTS: sdig pa thams cad 'byang zhing 'chi ba'i dus su bde ba nyid du dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /oM shwe ta wa ra bi dza li ne swA hA/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'i snying po 'di nyin lan bdun mtshan lan bdun brjod na las brgyud mar bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad 'byang zhing 'chi ba'i dus su gnad gcod pa'i sdug bsngal drag po mi 'byung ngo / /bde ba nyid du dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /oM sarba A ba ra Na bi skaM b+hi ne swA hA/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa de dag rnams la bshos gtsang la sogs pa'i mchod pas）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：166b4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya many+dzu shrI swA khyA to nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：gsum la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། འཕགས་པ 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ d+harma d+hA tu ni gardzi ta rA dzA ya།  ta thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te samyak+saM bud d+hA ya།  ན་མོ many+dzu shri ye།  ku mA ra b+hU tA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ dz+nyA nA lo ke།  tri rat+na paM sha saM d+hA ra Ni།  b+ha ga ba ti།  a bA yaM dA di a bA yaM dat+te me bo d+hi tsit+ta བཛྲ pa ri pA la ya།  sa man+ta a ba b+hA se na།  ha na ha na།  sarba satwa saM ta na pa ti taM།  kle shA nuts+tshe da ya།  ba ra lak+Sha Na།  a laM kr-i ta sha rI ri།  bo d+hi sa twa shi shU pa ti pA la ya།  bud d+hA na de shA ya།  de ba།  nA ga།  yak+Sha།  ga na d+harba།  a su ra།  ga ru Da།  kin+na ra།  ma ho ra ga ། ba shes+tha pA ya།  a pa yaM dad ti སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  གཟུངས 'di'i phan yon ni lan cig brjod pas kyang bskal pa stong du las kyi sgrib pa bsags pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro།  ། 'chi kar yang 'phags（EWTS: gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo rat+na tra yA ya/ na mo b+ha ga ba te d+harma d+hA tu ni gardzi ta rA dzA ya/ ta thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saM bud d+hA ya/ na mo many+dzu shri ye/ ku mA ra b+hU tA ya/ tad+ya thA/ o~M dz+nyA nA lo ke/ tri rat+na paM sha saM d+hA ra Ni/ b+ha ga ba ti/ a bA yaM dA di a bA yaM dat+te me bo d+hi tsit+ta badzra pa ri pA la ya/ sa man+ta a ba b+hA se na/ ha na ha na/ sarba satwa saM ta na pa ti taM/ kle shA nuts+tshe da ya/ ba ra lak+Sha Na/ a laM kr-i ta sha rI ri/ bo d+hi sa twa shi shU pa ti pA la ya/ bud d+hA na de shA ya/ de ba/ nA ga/ yak+Sha/ ga na d+harba/ a su ra/ ga ru Da/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga /ba shes+tha pA ya/ a pa yaM dad ti swA hA/ gzungs 'di'i phan yon ni lan cig brjod pas kyang bskal pa stong du las kyi sgrib pa bsags pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi kar yang 'phags）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。
